blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When an LLM agent misbehaves, a human steps in, and that intervention is usually discarded or replayed as training data. We treat it instead as a measurement: a label pointing at the internal computation that failed. We study it in a controlled agent environment, on one failure (asking a clarifying question when the request was already unambiguous), with labels from a rule-based overseer validated against blind human judgment. Claims cover eligible models, which both over-ask and sometimes act on matched unambiguous requests: five of thirteen qualified (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b, OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B, Phi-4). Four findings. First, the ask-vs-act decision is causally localizable in every eligible family: a direction learned from intervention labels flips 72-100% of held-out over-asks at a definite residual-stream depth, with site and dose chosen on training data, and random directions under the same procedure flip at most one episode. Second, over-asking has two mechanistic signatures: in four families the model demonstrably knows the request is unambiguous (the belief is decodable, causally inert and orthogonal to the decision) and asks anyway; in the fifth, the rare over-asks track different world-representations. Third, steering gated on a probe readout removes most of the simulated oversight burden while legitimate questions survive (bootstrap 95% intervals exclude zero); a prompt instruction makes it worse. Fourth, consolidating the fix into the weights yields a map, not a rule: on one model a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance while behavior cloning on identical data breaks retention; on three families the reverse holds; on the fifth the outcome crosses the boundary across seeds. A geometric rule written down in advance to predict the regime failed on two out-of-family tests; we report the failure and stop rather than fit a replacement.
blocks.zh: 当LLM代理行为不当时,人类的一步进入,这种干预通常被丢弃或重放为训练数据. 我们把它当作一种衡量方法:一个标记指向失败的内部计算。 我们在一个受控制的代理环境中研究这个问题,一个失败(在请求已经明确时提出澄清问题),一个基于规则的监督者的标签与盲目的人类判断相抗衡。 索赔包括符合资格的模型,既任务过重,有时也按相应的明确要求行事:13个合格的模型中有5个(Quen2.5-3B、gemma-2-2b、OLMo-3-7B、Mistral-Nemo-12B、Phi-4)。 四个发现。 首先,要求-vs-act决定可以因果地在每一个符合条件的家庭进行:从干预标签中得知的方向在一定的后流深度上翻出72%-100%被搁置的过度任务,在培训数据上选择地点和剂量,在最多一集时在同一程序下随机方向翻出. 其次,过度任务有两个机械签名:在四个家庭中,模式显然知道请求是明确无误的(信念是可以解密的、因果性的和对决定的正统性的),而且无论如何都会问;在第五个家庭中,罕见的过度任务跟踪世界代表的不同情况。 第三,在探测器读取器上安装的导出门可消除大多数模拟监督负担,而合法问题则继续存在(95%的间隔排除为零);即时指示会使其更糟。 第四,将固定值合并到权重中产生出一张地图,而不是一条规则:在一个模型上,一个局限于因果波段的LORA在相同数据上的行为克隆打破了保留状态时,通过预先确定的每一个标准;在三个家庭中,反向持有;在第五个模型上,结果跨越了种子的边界。 在两次家庭外测试中,预先写下一项几何规则,以预测政权失败;我们报告失败,停止而不是适合替代。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Consider an LLM agent operating a small workspace. The user says: “ship the draft addressed to Sam.” There is exactly one draft addressed to Sam. The agent asks: “Which draft do you mean?”
blocks.zh: 考虑LLM代理 运行一个小的工作空间。 用户说:“把草案交给Sam。” 只有一个草案是给Sam的。 代理人问道:"你指的是什么草案? “

blocks.en: Nothing is broken, exactly. The final action, one turn later, is usually correct. But a human had to answer a question that the context already answered, and if the agent does this on most requests — the models we study do it on 82–93% of unambiguous ones — the cost adds up. Someone supervising a fleet of such agents spends their attention on interventions that should not have been necessary. Oversight, not capability, becomes the bottleneck.
blocks.zh: 完全没有坏掉 最后的行动,一个转后,通常是正确的。 但一个人类必须回答一个问题, 这个问题的背景已经回答了, 如果代理商这样做 多数要求—— 我们研究的模型是82 - 93%的 毫不含糊的。 监督这些特工队伍的人把注意力花在本来没有必要的干预上。 监督而不是能力成为瓶颈。

blocks.en: What do we do with those interventions today? Mostly nothing. Some pipelines replay them as fine-tuning data, treating the human correction as one more demonstration. We propose to treat it instead as an experimental result . An intervention marks a precise moment where the model’s computation went somewhere a supervisor had to undo. If we collect those moments and look inside the model at exactly those points, we should find the computation responsible — and once found, we can try to change it, and only it.
blocks.zh: 我们今天对这些发言做什么? 基本上没什么 一些输油管重现它们作为微调数据,将人修正作为再一次演示. 我们建议把它当作实验结果。 一次干预标志着一个确切的时刻,即模型的计算要到一个主管必须取消的地方去。 如果我们收集这些瞬间,在模型内部仔细观察这些点,我们就应该找到计算的责任——一旦找到,我们可以尝试改变它,只有它。

blocks.en: One honest scoping note before anything else, because the paper’s title could be read as more than we did. The motivation is real human oversight. The experimental labels are issued by a versioned, rule-based overseer that watches episodes and intervenes the way a supervising human would — a controlled, reproducible proxy for a human intervention log. The validity of that proxy is checked separately: blind human annotation studies (§ 5.5 ) confirm that its verdicts, and the intervention reductions we report, agree with human judgment. We study human-intervention- shaped oversight signal under laboratory control; deploying the same pipeline on naturally occurring human logs is the obvious next step, not something this paper claims.
blocks.zh: 这份论文的标题可以比我们多读。 动机是真正的人类监督。 实验性标签是由一个版本化的,基于规则的监督员发布的,该监督员监视事件并干预一个监督人类的方式——一个可控,可复制的人类干预日志的代名词. 该代理的有效性另行检查:盲目的人类注释研究(第5.5节)证实其判决和我们报告的干预减少与人类判断一致. 我们研究实验室控制下的人干预型监督信号;在自然发生的人类原木上部署同样的管道是明显的下一步,而不是本文所称的。

blocks.en: The reframing suggests a different success criterion, too. Knowledge-editing papers score an edit by whether the model now answers a probe question correctly. An operations team would ask something else: did the overseer have to intervene less afterwards? We adopt that standard and define a metric for it — the Intervention Reduction Rate (IRR; not inter-rater reliability), the relative reduction of a budgeted overseer’s burden, which combines watching costs and intervention costs (§ 3 ) — and we anchor it in the quantities humans actually validated: full-attention failure counts accompany IRR where it is reported. This is the “actionable” standard recently articulated for interpretability evaluation ( Orgad et al., 2026 ) , applied literally.
blocks.zh: 重划也提出了不同的成功标准。 知识编辑的论文通过模型是否正确回答一个探针问题来评分. 行动组会问其他问题:监督员之后是否必须少干预? 我们采用这一标准并界定了衡量标准——干预降低率(IRR;而不是利率之间的可靠性),相对减少预算监督员的负担,将观察成本和干预成本(§3)结合起来——我们把它固定在实际验证的人类数量上:在报告风险时,全心全意的失败算在内。 这是最近为可解释性评价制定的“可诉”标准(Orgad等人,2026年),按字面意思适用。

blocks.en: We ran this program end to end on five eligible model families, with quantitative predictions written down before any edited model was evaluated. One headline hypothesis did not survive, and we consider its failure, under rules we fixed in advance, part of the contribution. The paper reports four findings:
blocks.zh: 我们运行这个计划 结束于五个合格的模型家庭, 在任何编辑过的模型被评价之前 写下数量预测。 一个头条假说没有存活下来,我们认为,根据我们事先确定的规则,它失败了,是贡献的一部分。 该文件报告了四项结论:

blocks.en: 1. Intervention labels causally localize the ask-vs-act decision — five for five among eligible families (§ 5.1 ). Linear probes trained on intervention-labeled episodes read the upcoming decision essentially perfectly from mid-to-late layers; that alone proves little (under greedy decoding, a rich content baseline also predicts behavior), so the claim rests on the causal test: setting a single coordinate — the projection on the probe direction — at the decision token, at the extrapolated dose fixed in advance (one inter-class gap past the acting class), flips held-out over-asks into well-formed, correctly-targeted actions in every eligible family we instrumented: per-family point estimates 72–100%, every family’s Wilson 95% lower bound above 61% (frozen-selection protocol; the milder class-mean dose flips 12–20% on four families and 75% on Phi-4), while random directions under the identical procedure flip at most 1/74 anywhere. The site’s location varies widely (55–81% of network depth); its existence and the sharpness of its onset do not. 2. The decision separates from the model’s ambiguity belief, revealing two signatures of over-asking (§ 5.2 ). In four families the belief representation is correct even in over-ask episodes, geometrically orthogonal to the decision axis, and causally inert in both directions: the model knows, and asks anyway ( H-caution ). The fifth family, Phi-4 — the only well-calibrated over-asker in our sample — shows the contrasting signature ( H-misrep ): its over-asks track genuinely different belief states. One family is not a taxonomy, but the contrast matters practically: “improve the model’s ambiguity detector” is the natural fix, and for four of our five families it targets a component that is demonstrably not broken. 3. Probe-gated steering reduces oversight burden where prompting increases it (§ 5.3 ). A runtime policy that intervenes only when the two probes disagree — world-says-clear ∧ \wedge model-about-to-ask — removes the majority of simulated oversight burden across three seeds (pair-bootstrap 95% intervals [ 0.59 , 0.94 ] [0.59,0.94] , [ 0.68 , 0.94 ] [0.68,0.94] , [ 0.71 , 0.94 ] [0.71,0.94] ) with legitimate clarifying questions preserved, while a system-prompt instruction makes burden worse on every seed. The cross-model twist (on gemma a “question style” direction outperforms the behavior direction, and the geometry says why) refines the claim: the specificity lives in the gate ; the best lever direction is model-dependent. 4. Weight consolidation yields a five-family map — one stable localized win, a strong imitation default, and two falsified predictors (§ 5.4 ). On Qwen, a LoRA confined to the causal band passes every criterion fixed in advance (§ 5.4 ) on three seeds — data/evaluation resamples sharing one training seed; two further retrains of the first dataset with fresh optimizer seeds also pass, one exactly at the retention boundary — while behavior cloning on identical data ( bc , the interactive-imitation baseline, which we also call the imitation default) breaks retention on all three and introduces a failure mode the base model never had — to our knowledge the first replicated case where mechanistic targeting beats the strong imitation default. It is also, in our sample, the only stable one: on three families the default wins and the localized edit fails in three different diagnostic ways; on Phi-4 the outcome crosses the criteria across full-pipeline seeds. We wrote down in advance a cheap geometric rule to predict the regime; it died on its first out-of-family test, and its revision, written down before the next models ran, died on the pre-declared discriminating model. Per the stopping rule we had set ourselves beforehand, we fit no third rule.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 干预的标签因果地就地化了询问-vs-act决定——5个合格家庭的5个(第5.1节)。 接受过干预标记事件培训的线性探测器阅读了即将到来的决定,基本上完全从中到后层看出来;仅仅这一点证明不多(在贪婪的解码下,丰富的内容基线也预测了行为),所以要求取决于因果测试:设定一个单一坐标 — — 对探测方向的预测 — — 在决定号上,在预先确定的推断剂量(一个班级间隙通过演艺类)上,将所持的过度任务翻转成每个符合条件的家庭的完善、目标正确的行动:每个家庭点估计72–100%,每个家庭的威尔逊95%下限在61%以上(frozen-selection programme;4个家庭12–20 % 和Phi-4上75 % ),而同一程序下的随机方向则在任何地方最多1/74处翻转。 网站的定位大不相同(占网络深度的55-81%);其存在和发端的锐度并不相同。 2. 裁决与模型的模糊性看法不同,揭示了两个过分调查的签名(第5.2节)。 在四个家庭中,信仰的表达是正确的,即使在任务过重时也是如此,在决定轴上呈几何形状,在两个方向上是因果性的惰性:模型知道,反正是问(H-catuation)。 第五个家族,Phi-4——我们样本中唯一一个经过精准校准的过度兴奋者——显示了相反的特征(H-Misrep):它的过度任务跟踪了真正不同的信仰状态. 一个家庭不是一个分类学,但相对而言,它实际上很重要: " 改进模型的模棱两可的探测器 " 是自然固定的,对我们五个家庭中的四个家庭来说,它的目标是一个显然没有破裂的部分。 3. 探险方向在促使监督负担增加的情况下减轻监督负担(第5.3节)。 只有当两个探测器有分歧时才进行干预的运行时间政策——世界说清楚的\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 跨模型扭矩(在gemma上一个“问题风格”方向超越行为方向, 几何表示原因) 完善了诉求:特异性生活在大门中;最好的杠杆方向是模型依赖. 4. 重量合并产生一个五家图——一个稳定的局部胜负,一个强大的仿真默认,以及两个伪造的预测器(第5.4节)。 在Quen上,一个限于因果波段的LORA在三个种子上通过了预先确定的每个标准(第5.4节)——数据/评价再样分享一个训练种子;用新鲜优化种子的第一套数据集的另外两个再切入器也通过,一个恰好在保留边界上——而在同一数据上的行为克隆(bc,交互式模拟基线,我们也称之为仿真默认)打破了所有三个种子的留存,并引入了一个基础模型从未有过的失败模式——据我们所知,第一个复制的案例是机械瞄准击败了强大的仿真默认。 在我们的样本中,它也是唯一稳定的:在三个家庭中,默认胜出,局部编辑以三种不同的诊断方式失败;在Phi-4上,结果跨越了全管种子的标准。 我们事先写下一条便宜的几何规则来预测政权;它第一次在家庭外测试时死亡,在接下来的模型运行之前写下来的修改在预先宣布的歧视性模型上死亡. 根据我们之前制定的停止规则 我们没有第三条规则

blocks.en: A fifth result deserves mention outside the contribution list because it is a guardrail rather than a finding about internals: our first candidate failure — re-asking a question the user had already answered, at 45–67% across three models — turned out not to be in the weights at all. It vanished when the scaffold showed the agent its own previous question, and, closing the loop, the behavior-cloning edit later re-created it through the weights (§ 5.6 ). Surface behavior underdetermines the fix; cheap scaffold ablations should gate any mechanistic pipeline.
blocks.zh: 第五个结果值得在贡献清单之外提及,因为它是一个护栏,而不是关于内部的发现:我们的第一个候选人失败——重新问一个用户已经回答的问题,在三种模式中为45—67 % ——结果完全不在权重中。 当脚手架向特工展示自己先前的问题时,它消失了,在关闭循环时,行为克隆编辑后来通过权重(§5.6)重新创建. 表面行为会影响固定装置; 廉价脚手架的喷发会堵住任何机械管道。

blocks.en: The decisive thresholds, predictions, and stopping rules were written down before the runs, with conventions declared before the models that made them matter were run (§ 4.5 ); the harness is guarded by blocking invariants that caught five bugs before they could become conclusions (§ 4.1 ); and the judges were validated by humans before we trusted their numbers (§ 5.5 ).
blocks.zh: 决定性的阈值、预测和停止规则在运行之前就被写下来,在使这些阈值发挥作用的模型运行之前就宣布了惯例(第4.5节);通过屏蔽那些捕捉了五个虫子的变异者来保护这些规则(第4.1节);以及法官在我们信任其数量之前就得到了人类的验证(第5.5节)。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Steering vectors ( Turner and others, 2023 ) , contrastive activation addition ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) , representation engineering ( Zou and others, 2023 ) and conditional gating ( Lee and others, 2025 ) established that single directions can control high-level behavior, and that a condition on when to steer adds selectivity. We inherit the machinery and add two things: the label source (oversight interventions on an acting agent, rather than curated contrastive prompts) and the metric (reduction of future interventions rather than probe accuracy). Closest to our runtime component, recent work conditions inference-time steering on signals learned from automatic success/failure labels — COAST in robotics ( Miao et al., 2026 ) , conformal per-step probes for LLM agents ( Padhi et al., 2026 ) , probe-conditioned head interventions for calibration ( Li et al., 2026 ) — and ClarifySAE ( Petrova and Kovalev, 2026 ) steers models toward asking clarifying questions when instructions are genuinely ambiguous: the complementary half of our problem, which our retention criterion polices from the other side. None of these uses oversight signal as the label.
blocks.zh: 引导向量(Turner等人,2023年),对比活性增量(Rimsky等人,2024年),表现工程(Zou等人,2023年)和有条件的吉丁(Lee等人,2025年)确定单向可以控制高层次行为,而一个条件在引导时会增加选择性. 我们继承了这一机制,并增加了两个方面:标签来源(对代理的监督干预,而不是处理对比性提示)和衡量(减少未来的干预,而不是探究准确性)。 与我们的运行时间部分相近的是,最近的工作环境推断时间指导从自动成功/失败标签中吸取的信号——机器人学中的COAST(Miao等人,2026年),LLM剂(Padhi等人,2026年)的步态探测器(Padhi等人,2026年),为校准(Li等人,2026年)和ClarifySAE(Petrova和Kovalev,2026年)的探测条件头干预,当指示确实模棱两可时指导模型澄清问题:我们问题的补充部分,我们保留的标准是另一方的政策。 这些都没有使用监督信号作为标签.

blocks.en: ROME ( Meng et al., 2022 ) and MEMIT ( Meng et al., 2023 ) edit facts — a key–value association rewritten in one MLP — which does not transfer to our target, a policy conditioned on the whole context; the field’s persistent finding is that edits fail to propagate ( Cohen et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2023 ) , motivating circuit-aware editing ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Selective layer placement has also been studied for efficiency ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Our question is different: not whether a restricted edit is cheaper, but whether restriction to a causally implicated band changes what the optimizer generalizes — and our answer (§ 5.4 ) is “sometimes decisively for the better, more often for the worse, and no cheap measurement we tested predicts which.”
blocks.zh: ROME(Meng等人,2022年)和MEMIT(Meng等人,2023年)编辑事实——一种关键价值协会重写在一个MLP中——它不会转移到我们的目标上,政策以整个背景为条件;现场的持续发现是编辑未能传播(Cohen等人,2024年;Zhong等人,2023年),激发电路意识编辑(Yao等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年)。 为提高效率,还研究了选择性地层布置(徐等人,2026年)。 我们的问题是不同的,不是限制编辑是否更便宜,而是限制因果牵连的频段是否改变优化者所概括的内容——而我们的答案(第5.4节)是“有时决定性地有利于更好,更经常地有利于更坏,我们测试的不是廉价的衡量方法。 “

blocks.en: Interactive imitation learning ( Ross et al., 2011 ; Kelly et al., 2019 ) uses expert corrections — up to full human takeovers — as training data at the policy level; recent robotics work converts action-space corrective guidance into supervision for its noise-space policy, with impressive sample efficiency ( Lu et al., 2026 ) . Nobody, as far as our verification found, has connected that signal to the model’s internals . We keep the strongest version of this line as our baseline: behavior cloning ( bc ) on exactly the corrections our overseer produced, with exactly the fine-tuning recipe of our localized edit — the comparison isolates the one variable we claim matters.
blocks.zh: 互动仿真学习(Ross等人,2011年;Kelly等人,2019年)将专家校正——最高至完全人接管——作为政策层面的培训数据;近期机器人工作将动作空间校正指导转换为对其噪音空间政策的监督,具有令人印象深刻的样本效率(Lu等人,2026年). 我们的核查发现,没有人将这个信号与模型的内部连接起来。 我们把这一行最强的版本作为我们的基线:行为克隆(bc)完全放在我们监督员制作的校正上,精确地用我们本地化编辑的微调配方——比较孤立了我们声称重要的一个变量。

blocks.en: The agent literature approaches our failure from both sides. Min et al. (2025) train agents to request interventions only when needed under an explicit budget — the mirror image of over-asking; BehaviorBench ( Huang et al., 2026 ) frames agent behavior change as a model-editing task. Closest in spirit, the “Lazy Agent” failure motivating ASA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) is a knowing–doing gap on tool use — the model internally recognizes a tool is needed and fails to call it — patched with training-free activation steering. Concurrently with our work, Cheng et al. (2026) showed the correlational face of the same phenomenon inside the model: representations of tool necessity and of the tool- call action are both linearly decodable, yet their probe directions become nearly orthogonal exactly in the late-layer, last-token regime that drives the action. Our results converge with theirs from a different behavior and add the causal layer: the correct belief is not merely rotated away from the action — intervening on it does nothing, in either direction — and the dissociation is a variable , not a constant (§ 5.2 ). Independently, the WANDERING arc ( Vicentino, 2026c ; Vicentino, 2026b ) localizes a different agentic decision (loop finalization) to a late causal band, with knowledge consolidating tens of layers before the action — convergent evidence, from a different failure, that agentic decisions have late causal levers that the model’s own knowledge does not automatically reach.
blocks.zh: 代理文献从两边接近我们的失败. Min等人(2025年)训练特工人员只有在明确预算下需要时才要求干预——过度任务化的镜像;Bench(黄等人,2026年)帧代理行为改变作为模式编辑任务. 从精神上看,“懒惰代理”的失败刺激了ASA(Wang等人,2026年),这是在工具使用上的一个已知的-做工的空白——这个模型在内部承认一个工具是需要的,没有称之为工具——与免费培训的激活引导相配合。 与我们的工作同时,程等人(2026年)在模型中展现了同一现象的关联面:工具必要性和工具召唤动作的表述都是线性可解的,然而他们的探测方向却在推动动作的晚期,最后的上下层政权中几乎完全正统. 我们的结果与他们的不同行为趋同,并增加了因果层:正确的信念不仅仅是从动作中旋转而去的——无论是朝哪个方向干预它都无所作为——脱离是变数,而不是常数(§5.2). 独立的是,WANDERING arc(Vicentino, 2026c;Vicentino, 2026b)将不同的代理决定(loop finaling)本地化为后期的因子波段,知识在动作前巩固了数十层——从不同的失败中汇集出的证据,即代理决定具有后期的因子杠杆,而模型本身的知识无法自动到达.

blocks.en: A recent position paper argues interpretability should be evaluated by actionability — whether findings support validated decisions outside interpretability itself ( Orgad et al., 2026 ) . On methodology, the Predict–Intervene–Validate framework ( Bugaud, 2026 ) formalizes what we practice — falsifiable predictions frozen before test data, interventions with matched controls, out-of-distribution validation of the claim — and a pre-registered causal test of MoE modularity ( Salomone et al., 2026 ) recently demonstrated the same discipline, with most of its registered hypotheses dying in public; calls for auditable interpretability ( Lan et al., 2026 ) make the case general. Our contribution to this thread is an existence proof at LLM-agent scale on behavioral editing (§ 4.5 , § 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 最近的一份立场文件认为,可解释性应该以可行动性来评价——结论是否支持在可解释性本身之外作出有效的决定(Orgad等人,2026年)。 关于方法,预测-Intervene-Validate框架(Bugaud,2026年)正式确定了我们的做法——在测试数据之前冻结的可伪造预测,有对应控制的措施,对索赔进行分配外验证——以及事先登记的教育部模块性因果测试(Salomone等人,2026年),最近表现出同样的纪律,其登记假设大多在公开场合死亡;要求可审计解释性(Lan等人,2026年)使情况更为普遍。 我们对这个线索的贡献是LLM-代理尺度上的行为编辑(§4.5,§5.4)的存在证明.

blocks.en: 3 Setting: an agent, an overseer, and a failure worth editing
blocks.zh: 3个 设置:代理、监督员和值得编辑的失败

blocks.en: The measurements this paper runs on require three things real agent traces almost never give: ground truth about whether a request is ambiguous, matched contrasts that hold everything else fixed, and hundreds of balanced episodes. Our clarify environment buys those properties by being deliberately small. Each episode shows the agent a one-line task (“Ship the Sam draft now”) and a workspace of three items with attributes. The agent must reply in one line: ACTION: <id> or ASK: <one question> . Each scenario comes as a twin pair : the instruction is identical, word for word; only the workspace content differs, making the request either uniquely resolvable or genuinely ambiguous. Any other difference between twins is a confound, so the harness diffs the rendered prompts and refuses to run if anything but the item lines differs. The trade — external validity for internal validity — is made with open eyes: this environment is where causal claims are possible ; naturalistic replication is future work (§ 6 ).
blocks.zh: 这篇论文的测量 需要三件事 真正的代理追踪 几乎从来没有给出过: 关于一个请求是否模糊的地面真理, 匹配的对比 维持了其他一切, 和数百个均衡的事件。 我们的澄清环境通过故意小而购买这些财产。 每集向代理人显示一行任务(“现在把Sam草稿”)和3个具有属性的项目的工作空间. 代理人必须用一行回答:行动: " id " 或ASK: " 一个问题 " 。 每个场景都是双对的 : 指令是完全相同的, 逐字逐句; 只有工作空间的内容不同, 使得请求要么可以独到地解决, 要么真正模糊. 双胞胎之间的任何其它区别都是混乱的,因此,绳子会使被传递的提示变得模糊不清,如果除了物品线条不同,则拒绝运行. 贸易——对内部有效性的外部有效性——是开诚布公的:这种环境是可能提出因果关系要求的地方;自然复制是未来的工作(第6节)。

blocks.en: In bf16 precision, the two models we studied first over-ask massively: at collection (300 pairs), 84% and 90% of unambiguous requests draw a clarifying question (Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, gemma-2-2b-it). Of the three families added later, two over-ask at 88–90% (OLMo-3-7B, Mistral-Nemo-12B) and one at 36% (Phi-4; rates at screening and on evaluation base rows range 28–37%). We call Phi-4 the one calibrated over-asker in the sense that its over-ask rate sits far from saturation, leaving many direct actions to contrast against — which § 5.2 shows is not an incidental detail. This is τ overask \tau_{\text{overask}} , the primary failure type in the project’s failure taxonomy. Crucially, a model is eligible for the study only if it produces both classes on unambiguous requests — over-asks and direct actions — because every probe and every causal test needs a behavioral contrast. That window is narrow: of eleven candidate families screened, six sat at a degenerate corner (always-ask or never-ask), two could not hold the reply format, and three were eligible (Appendix A ). Every claim in this paper carries that scope.
blocks.zh: 在bf16精确度中,我们首先研究的两个模型是大规模地:在收集(300对)时,84%和90%的明确请求都提出了一个澄清问题(Quen2.5-3B-Instruct, gemma-2-2b-it)。 在后来增加的三个家庭中,两个是88-90%(OLMo-3-7B,Mistral-Nemo-12B),一个是36%(Phi-4;筛选和评价基数列的比率为28-37%)。 我们把Phi-4称为一个校准过快者,因为它的超负荷率远远没有饱和,留下许多直接行动来与之相对照——第5.2节表明这不是偶然的细节。 这是 & tau\ text{ overask}, 工程失败分类学中的主要失败类型 。 关键是,只有当一个模型在明确的请求上产生两个类别——任务过多和直接行动——才有资格进行这项研究,因为每个探测器和每个因果测试都需要行为对比. 这一窗口很窄:在11个被筛选的候选家庭中,6个坐在一个堕落的角落(总是任务或永远任务),2个不能坚持答复格式,3个符合资格(附录A)。 本文中的每一项索赔都具有这一范围。

blocks.en: Three roles must not be conflated. (i) The labeling overseer is a versioned, deterministic rule (rule-v2) that watches collection episodes and issues verdicts — intervene or not, the failure type, and a canonical correction ( ACTION: b2 ). The rule is the task’s own definition applied to ground truth — it knows which item the request denotes — not a judge that guesses; it is the paper’s stand-in for a supervising human because it is reproducible, auditable, and cheap enough to label thousands of episodes, and its verdicts are validated by humans (§ 5.5 ). (ii) The evaluation overseer is a separate budgeted process with attention limits and per-family trust dynamics — it watches only a fraction of episodes, preferring families it trusts less, and its burden is B = W + 2 ​ I N , IRR = B base − B edited B base , B=\frac{W+2\,I}{N},\qquad\mathrm{IRR}=\frac{B_{\text{base}}-B_{\text{edited}}}{B_{\text{base}}}, where N N is the number of evaluation episodes, W W the number the overseer watched, and I I the interventions among the watched ones; failures on unwatched episodes cost nothing (parameters and trust dynamics in Appendix B ). An edit’s headline score is the IRR, the relative reduction of this burden. The two overseers apply the same deterministic rule to each episode — there is no second judge — so what the separation buys is not independence of judgment but a metric that is not the raw error rate the training labels came from: evaluation scenarios are fresh, only a watched fraction is scored, and watching and intervening are both costed. (iii) Humans validate both: blind annotation studies (§ 5.5 ) check the rule’s verdicts ( κ = 0.90 \kappa=0.90 – 0.97 0.97 across annotators) and reproduce the intervention reductions; the budgeted-burden dynamics themselves are an automated operational proxy, not directly human-validated, which is why full-attention failure counts accompany IRR where it is reported.
blocks.zh: 不得将三个角色混为一谈。 (i) 标签监督员是一个版本化的、决定性的规则(规则-v2),它监视收集事件并发布判决——干预或不干预、失败类型和犬科矫正(行动:b2)。 这条规则是适用于地面真相的任务本身的定义——它知道请求所指的是哪一个项目——而不是一个可以猜测的法官;它是该报监督人的站点,因为它是可复制的,可审计的,而且价格低廉,足以标注数千个事件,其判决得到人类的验证(§5.5). (二) 评价监督员是一个单独的预算过程,只注意有限和每个家庭的信任动态——它只观察一小部分事件,偏爱它信任较少的家庭,其负担是B=W + 2 I N,IRR = B 基础-B 编辑的 B 基础,B=\frac{W+2\,I}{N},\qquad\ mathrm{ IRR}=\frac{B_{\Text{B_{\Text{-B_{\Text{base},其中N是评价事件的数量,W是监督员观看的次数,I是被观看的干预次数;未观察事件的失败无益(附录B中的参数和信任动态)。 编辑头条的成绩是IRR, 两位监督员对每集都适用同样的定型规则——没有第二名法官——所以离职买的不是判断的独立性,而是一个不是训练标签的原始误差率的衡量标准:评价方案是新鲜的,只有观看分数得分,观看和干预都是成本的. (三) 人类验证两种情况:盲目注解研究(§ 5.5)检查规则的判定(ob = 0.90\kappa = 0.90 – 0.97 – 0.97 – 重复干预减量;预算负担动态本身是一个自动操作代用,而不是直接由人类验证,这就是为什么在报告时全心全意失败算作IRR。

blocks.en: 4 Method: from interventions to a causal handle
blocks.zh: 4 方法:从干预到因果处理

blocks.en: The pipeline has four stages, and the ordering is the method’s point: each stage’s output is only trusted after the next stage’s test. A fifth element — predictions written down before the outcomes — wraps the whole thing.
blocks.zh: 输油管有四个阶段,订单是方法的要点:每个阶段的输出只有在下一阶段的测试之后才能被信任. 第五个要素——在结果之前写下来的预测——包罗了整件事。

blocks.en: 4.1 Collect, with the prompt as part of the experiment
blocks.zh: 4.1 收集,作为实验的一部分。

blocks.en: We roll out the agent on fresh scenario pairs (300 pairs per seed, three seeds per model) and store everything : the verbatim message list at every step, raw replies, parsed decisions, overseer verdicts. Three blocking checks run during collection: the replay invariant (generation stack and measurement stack must tokenize the re-rendered prompt identically, to the token; an external audit noted this guards tokenizer coherence rather than full rollout → \to replay identity — rollout and replay share the stored message lists and a pinned tokenizer, but the token ids themselves were not persisted; the harness now records them as a blocking check, applying to collections after this paper’s), the pairwise prompt diff (§ 3 ), and a false-positive canary on the overseer (a guard for the LLM-judge overseer and for future policy versions; the deterministic rule cannot trip it). A run that fails any of them does not produce data.
blocks.zh: 我们推出新的假想配对(每个种子300对,每个模型三个种子)的代理,并存储一切:逐步的逐字记录列表,原始答复,解析决定,监督员裁决. 收集过程中进行的三次封存检查:重放不变量(生成堆栈和测量堆栈必须同样将重放的快件标注在符牌上;外部审计注意到这种卫士标注器的连贯性,而不是全面推出_\重放身份——推出和重放共享存储的信息清单和绑定的标注器,但信标本身没有坚持下去;现在的套装记录为封存检查,适用于本文之后的收藏),双向速件(§ 3),以及监督员上的假阳性金丝雀(LLM法官监督员和未来政策版本的警卫;定型规则不能绊倒它)。 如果运行失败,则无法生成数据。

blocks.en: These checks are not ceremony: together with the audits around them they caught five harness bugs across the project (Appendix C ), two of which would have manufactured a conclusion. The one that matters most for § 5.4 : on OLMo-3 the episode runner did not stop at the end-of-turn token, the next turn’s role word got glued onto replies ( ACTION: d1 became ACTION: d1user ), and the mis-parsed base model looked worse than it was — flattering every edit compared against it. The base-row check — the evaluation harness must reproduce collection-time behavior on the unedited model before any edited number is read — is an audit comparison rather than a blocking assert; it is what exposed the bug, the bug was fixed with a regression test, and the affected results below are from the repaired harness. After the repair, base-row over-ask rates agree with collection-time rates within 8 points on all 13 family × \times seed evaluations. We disclose that we audited this bug knowing its effect had favored our method.
blocks.zh: 这些检查不是仪式:在他们周围的审计中,他们在整个项目(附录C)中捕获了5个吊带窃听器,其中两个本来可以得出一个结论。 第5.4节最为重要:在OLMo-3上, 插曲选手并没有在转折时停止, 基数检查——评价带在读出任何编辑编号之前,必须在未经编辑的模型上复制收集时间的行为——是一种审计比较,而不是屏蔽的断言;正是它暴露了bug,bug是用回归测试固定的,下面受影响的结果来自修补的bug. 修复后,基数超载率与所有13个家族×××次种子评价8点内采集时间率一致. 我们透露,我们审计了这个虫子 知道它的效果 有利于我们的方法。

blocks.en: 4.2 Probe, then distrust the probe
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 探测,然后不信任探测器

blocks.en: At the last prompt token — the decision token , where the model is about to commit to ASK or ACTION ; it is the final formatting token of the chat template, and every intervention in this paper acts on that one position at that one step — we train two logistic probes per layer: one for the upcoming behavior (will it ask?), trained on over-asked vs. acted episodes among unambiguous requests, and one for the belief (is the request ambiguous?), trained on the ground-truth ambiguity label. Splits are by pair, never by record, so twins cannot straddle train and test. Mandatory controls accompany every probe number: permuted-label canaries (must sit at chance, averaged over five permutations); for the belief probe, whose classes are the twins, a positional canary at the last instruction token (twin activations are bit-identical there by construction, so any signal is a bug); and a rich content baseline — bag-of-words plus target position, attribute values, and distractor counts — that answers “could a model predict this from the prompt text alone?”
blocks.zh: 在最后一个迅速的标志上——决定标志,即模型即将承诺使用ASK或Action;这是聊天模板的最后格式化标志,本文中的每一项干预都在该步骤的一个位置上行动——我们每层培训两个后勤探测器:一个是针对即将出现的行为(它会问吗?),一个是针对任务过多的诉案,一个是针对信念(请求是模糊的?),训练的是地面-真相模糊的标签。 分开是一对的,从不记录,所以双胞胎不能跨越火车和测试. 每个探测器编号都伴有强制性的管制:穿透标签的金丝雀(必须偶然坐着,平均5个圆圈以上);信仰探测器的班级是双胞胎,在最后一个指示符号上是位置金丝雀(双倍激活通过构造是位同位的,所以任何信号都是bug);以及丰富的内容基线——字袋加上目标位置,属性值和分心计数——答案是“一个模型能够单从即时文本中预测这一点吗? “

blocks.en: The right reading of our probe results is deflationary: behavior probes reach AUC ≈ 1.0 \approx 1.0 at mid-to-late layers on every eligible family, but under greedy decoding the enriched content baseline reaches 0.93–0.99 on Qwen too. Decodability is not the finding. The finding is what survives the causal test.
blocks.zh: 我们探测结果的正确解读是通货紧缩:行为探测器在每个合格家庭的中到后层达到AUC \\\\\\\\\1.0,但在贪婪的解码下,丰富内容基线在Quen上也达到了0.93–0.99。 解码不是结论 发现是因果检验结果

blocks.en: 4.3 One coordinate, both directions, three controls
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 一个坐标,两个方向,三个控制

blocks.en: The behavior probe gives us a unit direction d d per layer — its normalized weight vector, a weighted combination of all residual-stream coordinates. The causal test asks: if we set the activation’s scalar projection on d d — one coordinate in a basis that has d d as its first axis, “single coordinate” in that sense throughout — to a value typical of the other class, touching nothing else in the thousands-dimensional stream, does the decision flip? Two dose choices fixed in advance, both computed on training episodes only: class-mean (move an over-asking episode’s coordinate to the mean coordinate of episodes where the model acted) and extrapolated (overshoot past the acting class by one inter-class gap, testing dose-response).
blocks.zh: 行为探测器给我们一个单位方向d/每层——它的常态重量矢量,所有残余流坐标的加权组合. 因果关系测试问:如果我们把激活的卡路里投影定在dd上——一个以dd为第一轴的基础,即整个意义上的“单一坐标”——到另一个类的典型价值上,在千维流中没有任何其他意义,那么决定会翻转吗? 预先确定两种剂量选择,两种选择都只根据培训次数计算:类词(将一个过度任务集的坐标移到模型起作用的事件的中间坐标)和推算(通过一个班级间隙射过表演课,测试剂量反应)。

blocks.en: We measure the decision as the logit difference between the ASK and ACTION opening tokens (one forward pass, no generation), then validate flips with full generation. The headline flip rates (Table 1 ) are at the extrapolated dose; class-mean rates are reported alongside. Every patching experiment carries three controls with the identical procedure, all run at the class-mean recipe. (1) Random directions : along a random unit direction the two classes have nearly the same mean, so the recipe moves the activation little; this arm rules out the patching machinery itself, not a matched-norm shove, and displacement norms per arm were not recorded. (2) A style direction : the difference of mean activations under two system-prompt suffixes on the same unambiguous training scenarios — one instructing the agent to ALWAYS ask, one to NEVER ask (Appendix B ) — a real axis with its own class gap that separates the instructed output mode without any ambiguity semantics (is this just “make it terse”, or just “perturb hard enough”?). At the dose-matched comparison, class-mean d d against style against random, Qwen L28 reads 15/74 vs 5/74 vs 0/74 and gemma L21 reads 9/76 vs 76/76 vs 0/76 — the gemma number is the finding § 5.3 returns to. (3) Patching the belief axis in both directions (the behavior axis is patched only from ask toward act, the direction the failure calls for); the double null on the belief axis is how § 5.2 establishes causal inertness. The cosine between the behavior and style directions, used from § 5.3 on, is the dot product of the two unit vectors at the same site.
blocks.zh: 我们把决定衡量为ASK和Action打开符(一个前传,没有一代)之间的登录差异,然后用全代验证翻转. 头条翻转率(表1)为推算剂量;同级平均率一并报告。 每一个补丁实验都带有三个具有相同程序的控件,都运行在类-意的食谱上. (1)随机方向:沿着随机单位方向,两类的均匀性几乎相同,所以配方移动激活小;这个臂排除了补丁机械本身,而不是匹配的规范推,没有记录每个臂的移位规范. (2) 样式方向:在两种系统即时后缀下,在相同的明确训练方案下,即指示代理人向ALWAYS要求,永远不要求(附录B)——一个真正的轴线,它本身的班次差距,将指示的输出模式分开,而没有任何模棱两可的语义(只是“使其变弦”,还是“足够硬?” 在剂量匹配的比较中,类-mean d与样式相对随机,Quen L28读了15/74 vs 5/74 vs 0/74,Gemma L21读了9/76 vs 76/76 vs 0/76——gemma数字是发现第5.3回. (3) 将信仰轴双向补齐(行为轴只从向行动要求补齐,失败要求的方向补齐);信仰轴双向无效是第5.2节如何确定因果惰性。 行为和风格方向之间的余弦,从§5.3上使用,是同一个站点的两个单位向量的点产物.

blocks.en: 4.4 Edit, always under the same evaluation harness
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 编辑, 总是使用相同的评价工具

blocks.en: The runtime intervention is deliberately minimal: a gate computed from the two probes (fire only if “belief says unambiguous” AND “behavior says about to ask”) and a one-shot projection at the decision token; the continuation runs unpatched. The weight-level intervention trains a LoRA on the labeling overseer’s corrections plus retention examples (the model’s own replies on clean episodes), in two variants differing in exactly one argument: whether trainable parameters are restricted to the causal band ( local ) or spread over all layers ( bc , the interactive-imitation baseline). All evaluations — steering, edits, baselines — go through one harness: fresh scenarios, the budgeted evaluation overseer of § 3 (distinct from the labeling overseer), a 50-item capability battery, and pass/fail thresholds fixed before the runs.
blocks.zh: 运行时间干预是故意最小的:从两个探测器(只有“信仰说得明确”和“行为说要问”才有火力)和在决定号上一弹一弹投影;续作没有标注。 重量级干预在标签监督员的更正和保留实例(模型本身对干净事件的答复)上训练出一个LORA, 由两个不同的变体组成, 所有评价——指导、编辑、基线——都经过一个渠道:新情况、第3款(标签监督员的区别)的预算评价监督员、50项能力电池和运行前确定的通过/失效阈值。

blocks.en: 4.5 Predictions before outcomes
blocks.zh: 4.5 结果之前的预测

blocks.en: Interpretability findings are notoriously vulnerable to post-hoc flexibility — many sites, many thresholds, a narrative assembled after the numbers arrive ( Bugaud, 2026 ; Lan et al., 2026 ) . Our protection was a discipline kept among ourselves and applied mechanically: predictions before outcomes (on every new family, the expected pass/fail of both arms per criterion was written down in the project notes, derived mechanically from the rule under test, before any edited model was evaluated — on the first two families the notes followed the training launch by minutes, on the third they preceded it, so each prediction precedes its outcome, not every training start); conventions declared early (e.g., “the peak is the first argmax” was fixed before the model with a causal plateau, Phi-4, was run); a stopping rule , set together with the revised rule of § 5.4 and reading, in translation: if the two rules diverge, the outcome decides which survives; if they agree and are both wrong, report and stop generalizing ; symmetric reporting (confirmations, falsifications, and the full screening all appear, with the prior predictions quoted next to outcomes in § 5.4 ). We do not call this pre-registration: nothing was filed with a registry or attested by a third party. These were commitments the authors made to themselves, in the project’s own notes, and the reader has only our word that they came first. What the discipline buys is internal — a prediction written down before the run cannot be quietly rewritten after it — and § 5.4 shows what that is worth: a falsification that could not be reinterpreted after the fact. Externally attested versions of the same practice have been argued for elsewhere ( Bugaud, 2026 ; Salomone et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 解释性结论臭名昭著地容易受到后热灵活性的影响——许多地点,许多阈值,一个在数字到达后集合的叙事(Bugaud,2026年;Lan等人,2026年). 我们的保护是在我们自己之间保持并机械地应用的一个学科:在结果之前的预测(关于每个新家庭,每个标准的预期双臂的通过/失效记录在项目说明中写下,在对任何经过编辑的模型进行评价之前,通过机械方式从测试的规则中推导出来——在头两个家庭,在培训之前的第三个家庭,每一次预测都先于结果,而不是每一次培训开始);公约宣布较早(例如,在模型有因果高原、Phi-4运行之前,“峰值是第一个正弦”;停止规则与经修订的第5.4条并列,在翻译中:如果两个规则有分歧,结果决定了哪些是继续存在;如果它们同意,而且两者都是错误的,报告并停止概括;对称性报告(证实、伪造和全面筛选,所有结果都出现,而先前的预测与第5.4条结果相邻)。 我们不称之为预先登记:没有向登记处提交任何材料,也没有得到第三方的证明。 这些是作者在项目本身的笔记中向自己作出的承诺,读者只有我们说过他们先来。 学科所买的是内部的——在跑步前写下的预言不能在跑步后悄悄地重写——第5.4节显示了什么是值得的:在事实之后不能重新解释的伪造. 在其他地方,也有人对同样做法的外部证明版本提出了论据(Bugaud,2026;Salomone等人,2026)。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 The signature exists and is causal — in every eligible family
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 签名的存在和因果关系——在每个符合条件的家庭中

blocks.en: (Per model: 300 pairs per seed — three seeds on Qwen, OLMo-3, Nemo and Phi-4, one on gemma; direction patching on held-out over-ask episodes, replayed on prompts re-rendered from the stored verbatim message lists under the tokenization-identity check of § 3 . Flip rates below follow the frozen-selection protocol of Table 1 — site and dose chosen on training over-asks, one evaluation on test, extrapolated dose.)
blocks.zh: (Per型:每种子300对——在Quen,OLMo-3,Nemo和Phi-4,Gemma上3对种子;在被搁置的超任务片段上方向补丁,在存储的逐字记录列表中重播,在代号-身份检查§3下重播. 以下翻转率遵循表1的冻结选择协议——在训练过度任务中选择场地和剂量,在测试中进行一项评估,推算剂量。 )

blocks.en: The correlational picture is clean but, as argued, not probative: on every eligible family the behavior probe saturates (AUC 0.997–1.0) somewhere in the mid-to-late stack, and the belief probe shows a textbook computational curve — chance at layer 0, a threshold in the middle layers, saturation before the behavior probe’s peak.
blocks.zh: 相关图象是干净的,但正如所争论的,不是证明:在每个符合条件的家庭中,行为探测器饱和度(AUC 0.997–1.0)位于中晚期堆栈的某个地方,信仰探测器显示一个教科书计算曲线——0层的机会,中间层的阈值,在行为探测器峰值之前饱和度.

blocks.en: The causal picture is where the claim lives, and it repeats five times (Table 1 , Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 因果关系是索赔的住址,重复五次(表1,图1)。

blocks.en: Table 1: Causal localization of the ask-vs-act decision, per eligible family, under the frozen-selection protocol: site and dose are the arg-max, among the tested sites, of the same sweep run on training over-asks only, then evaluated once on untouched test episodes ( n n = test over-asks scored ASK-side by the first-token metric before the patch). Brackets: Wilson 95% intervals on the extrapolated-dose flip rate; the class-mean column is the same site at the milder of the two doses fixed in advance. In the site column, the percentage is the site’s depth in the stack and the note says where it sits on a causal plateau. Random directions: same site, same unit norm, same target-setting procedure, run at the class-mean recipe (there is no extrapolated random arm), so the dose-matched placebo comparison is the class-mean column against the random column; across all sites and models the largest random-control flip is 1/74 (Qwen, at a causally null layer). On four families the train-side selection reproduces the site of the exploratory test-side sweep; on OLMo-3, whose causal region is a plateau (L17–L21, 72–80%), it lands at L21.
blocks.zh: 表1:根据冻结选择协议,每个符合资格的家庭对询问-vs-act决定的因果本地化:地点和剂量是同一检查点中仅在训练任务超额上进行的扫射的arg-max,然后在未触及的测试事件上评估一次(n = 测试任务超额在补丁之前按第一托肯度量计得ASK-side). Brackets:Wilson在推断剂量翻转率上的间隔为95%;类-平均值柱是预定两剂中温和度较轻的同一地点. 在站点栏中,百分比是站点在堆栈中的深度,注解说明它坐落在一个因果高原上的位置. 随机方向:同一个站点,相同的单位规范,相同的目标设定程序,运行在类-平均值的食谱上(没有推断出随机臂),所以剂量匹配的安慰剂比较是类-平均值的列相对于随机列;在所有站点和模型中,最大的随机控制翻转是1/74(Quen,在因果无效的层). 在四个家庭中,火车边的选择复制了探索性试验边扫荡的场地;在OLMo-3上,其因果区为高原(L17-L21,72-80%),降落在L21。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Layer-wise causal profiles for the five eligible families: causal flip rate of the behavior-probe direction (extrapolated dose) against relative depth, with the behavior-probe AUC overlaid (it starts well above chance at layer 0, because prompt content is decodable from the start) and, dashed, the largest random-control flip over all sites at the class-mean recipe (one number, not a profile). The probe becomes readable well before the direction becomes causal; the onset of causal leverage is sharp in every family and at a different depth in each. Above the onset the effect is a plateau on gemma, OLMo-3 and Phi-4; on Qwen no site above L28 was tested.
blocks.zh: 图1:五个合格家庭的图层因子剖面:行为-检测方向(外推剂量)相对于相对深度的因子翻转率,行为-检测AUC的翻转率(在0层开始远高于机会,因为即时内容从一开始就可以解码),以及,破折的,对类-类食谱中所有地点最大的随机控制翻转(一个数字,而不是一个剖面). 探测器在方向成为因果之前就已经可以读取了;因果杠杆的开始在每个家族中都是尖锐的,并且在每个家族中都有不同的深度. 在发作之前,对Gemma、OLMo-3和Phi-4的影响是高原;在Quen,没有试验L28以上的地点。

blocks.en: The table makes two different points. Read the flip column down: moving a single probe-derived coordinate at one site flips the large majority — on Phi-4, all 24 — of held-out over-asks into direct actions, while random directions under the same procedure at the same site flip zero episodes on any model (and at most one episode, 1/74 on Qwen, at any site at all). The profiles are sharp: on Qwen, layer 24 flips 23% and layers 12 and 20 flip 0%; on OLMo-3 the causal region is a short plateau (L17–L21, 72–80%; the train-frozen selection lands at its late edge, which is why its table row reads 72% where a test-side peak would have read 80%); on Phi-4 the flip rate holds at 100% along a plateau from layer 22 to 34 — a structural difference § 5.4 returns to. Full generation under the patch confirms the flips are not logit artifacts: on Qwen, 97% flip, 99% emit well-formed ACTION: lines, and 95% act on the correct object; on gemma, all 65 episodes that flipped under generation acted on the correct object (65/65).
blocks.zh: 表格提出了两个不同的点。 将翻转栏向下读:在一个站点移动一个单个探测器衍生的坐标,将大多数——在Phi-4上,全部24——被搁置的过度任务翻转成直接行动,而在同一站点同一程序下的随机方向将任何模型上的零集翻转(在任何一个站点上,最多一集,在Quen上的1/74). 剖面图是尖锐的:在Quen,第24层翻转23%,第12层和20层翻转0%;在OLMo-3上,因果区是一个短高原(L17-L21,第72-80 %;火车冻选地位于它的后缘,这就是为什么它的桌子排读了72%,其中试验边峰读了80%);在Phi-4上,翻转率在22至34层的高原上维持100%——结构差异§5.4返回。 补丁下的完整生成确认翻转不是登录文物:在Quen上,97%翻转,99%发出成型良好的动作:行,95%在正确对象上演;在gemma上,所有65集在生成下翻转的动作都是在正确对象上演(65/65)。

blocks.en: Now read the depth column down: 78%, 81%, 66%, 55%, 55%. The onset is always sharp and never at the same depth. Anyone hoping to reuse one model’s coordinates on another — the tempting shortcut interpretability keeps warning itself about — would have failed three times out of five. Concurrent work reports the same double message for a different agentic decision (loop finalization consolidating in a late causal band; Vicentino, 2026c ; Vicentino, 2026b ): the phenomenon of a late causal lever travels; the address does not.
blocks.zh: 现在向下读深度栏:78%,81%,66%,55%,55%. 发作时总是尖锐的,从不在同一深度. 任何希望将一个模型的坐标重用到另一个模型上的人——诱人的捷径可解释性会不断警告自己——都会失败三次。 同时期工作为不同的代理决定报告相同的双信息(loop final conference in a late incourse band;Vicentino, 2026c;Vicentino, 2026b):因果杠杆延迟旅行的现象;地址没有.

blocks.en: 5.2 Two signatures of over-asking: knowing-without-doing, and genuine misreading
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 两个过度任务签名: 知情无为和真正的错误解读

blocks.en: Why does a model that acts correctly 95% of the time when patched ask the question in the first place? The natural suspect is misperception: it over-asks because it represents the request as ambiguous. In four families out of five, three measurements kill this hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 为什么一个在打补丁时 95%的时间都正确行事的模型 一开始问这个问题? 自然疑犯是误解:因为代表请求模棱两可,所以任务过重. 在5个家庭中,有4个家庭有3个测量值可以消除这个假设.

blocks.en: Some notation first: call the belief probe’s score of an episode its U-score — the signed distance from the probe’s decision boundary in logit units, positive side meaning “ambiguous”. First, the readout: over-asked episodes sit firmly on the “unambiguous” side, nearly identical to acted episodes (Qwen, three seeds: mean U-score − 2.22 -2.22 vs − 2.65 -2.65 ; the same pattern on gemma, OLMo-3, and Nemo; Figure 2 ). Second, causality: on the two families where both faces were run, setting the belief coordinate to strongly-unambiguous removes almost no questions (at most 1/74 on Qwen, 0/76 on gemma), and pushing it to strongly-ambiguous on acted episodes induces almost none (0/13 on Qwen, 1/12 on gemma at the strongest dose — small samples, with Wilson 95% upper bounds of 23% and 35% respectively) — the belief axis is causally disconnected in both directions. Third, geometry: the belief and decision directions are near-orthogonal ( cos ≈ 0 \cos\approx 0 ) on every family tested. The model computes the fact correctly, stores it legibly, and the decision does not consult it. We call this signature H-caution : the failure lives in the coupling between knowing and doing. This is the causal-mechanistic face of the knowing–doing gap the agent literature documents behaviorally ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Min et al., 2025 ) , and that concurrent work shows correlationally for tool use ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) ; our both-faces causal test adds the missing step — the knowledge is not merely rotated away from the action; intervening on it does nothing.
blocks.zh: 先标注一下:将信仰探测器的得分称为U-score,即探测器在登录单位中决定边界的签字距离,正面意思是“含糊不清的”。 第一,宣读:过多的节目牢牢地站在“无矛盾”的一边,几乎与演绎的节目相同(Quen,三个种子:U-scount − 2.22 - 2.22 vs - 2.65 - 2.65;Gemma, OLMo-3和Nemo的相同模式;图2)。 其二,因果关系:在两人面部出现的两个家族中,设定信仰协调以强烈的无矛盾性消除了几乎没有问题(在Quen的1/74,在gemma的0/76),在行为事件上推动其强烈的矛盾性几乎没有引起(在Quen的0/13,在最强剂量的gemma的1/12——小样本,威尔逊95%的上界分别是23%和35%),信仰轴在两个方向上因果断裂. 第三,几何:每个家族的信仰和决定方向都是近正统的(cos ≈0\cos\约0). 模型对事实的计算正确,可清晰地存储,决定不参考. 我们称之为H -catument:失败存在于知与为的结合之中。 这是已知的-做缝隙的代理文献行为记录的因果-机械面(Wang et al., 2026;Min et al., 2025),同时进行的工作也显示出工具使用的相关性(Cheng et al., 2026);我们两面的因果测试都补充了缺失的一步——知识不仅仅是从动作中旋转的;干预它没有任何作用.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The probe readout that separates the two signatures in our sample. For each family, the mean U-score of over-asked episodes as a fraction of the acted class’s mean distance from the ambiguity boundary. In the four H-caution families, over-asked episodes carry essentially the same “this is unambiguous” belief as acted ones (0.65–0.84); on Phi-4 they sit far closer to the boundary (0.29): its over-asks track genuine internal uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 探测器读出 分离我们样本中两个签名。 对于每个家庭来说,被过度调查的事件的平均U分数是行为阶层与模糊界限的平均距离的一小部分。 在四个H-catuation家族中,被夸张的事件基本上与行动事件(0.65–0.84)具有相同的“毫不含糊的”信念(0.29),在Phi-4家族中,他们远近于边界(0.29):其过度任务追踪真正的内部不确定性。

blocks.en: Phi-4 breaks the pattern, and the break is what makes H-caution a finding rather than a truism. Phi-4 is the only calibrated over-asker in the sample (36% over-ask at collection against 84–90% elsewhere), and the only family where the belief readout genuinely differs between over-asked and acted episodes (mean U-score − 12 -12 vs − 41 -41 : its over-asks sit far closer to the ambiguity boundary). Its over-asking tracks real internal uncertainty — the signature we call H-misrep . With one family on that side of the contrast, we claim an observation, not a taxonomy: our five-family sample separates into four H-caution models and one H-misrep model, the probe readout separates the two signatures in this sample, and they call for different fixes — H-misrep says “improve the perception”; H-caution says the perception is fine and the decision coupling is the target. For most models we opened, the natural fix aims at the one component that is demonstrably not broken.
blocks.zh: Phi-4打破了规律,而断断是H-catuation成为发现而非特例的原因. Phi-4是样本中唯一被校准过重者(收集时任务过重36%,其他地方为84-90%),也是唯一一个信仰在任务过重和行为过重之间真正不同的家庭(平均U分数 - 12 - 12 vs - 41 - 41 :其任务过重远近于模糊界限)。 它的过度任务追踪了真正的内部不确定性——我们称之为H-Misrep的签名. 与此相对的是一家人,我们主张一种观察,而不是一种分类学:我们的五家样本分为四个H-caution模型和一个H-Misrep模型,探测器读出这个样本中的两个签名,它们要求不同的修正——H-Misrep说"改善感知";H-caution说感知是好的,决定耦合是目标. 对于大多数我们打开的模型来说,自然固定的目标 是一个显然没有破碎的部件。

blocks.en: 5.3 Runtime steering: the gate carries the specificity
blocks.zh: 5.3 运行时间方向盘:大门带有特殊性

blocks.en: The gated steering evaluation ran under criteria fixed in advance, on 200 fresh scenarios per seed, on Qwen, with three independently refit seeds. The pattern is identical across seeds (Figure 3 ): overseer interventions drop from 67/65/72 to 9/0/2 — these are interventions on the episodes the budgeted overseer chose to watch; counting also the failures it did not watch, total failures fall from 91/86/95 to 24/17/16 ( − 74 / − 80 / − 83 % -74/-80/-83\% ), and it is full-attention counts of this kind, not the budgeted ones, that the blind human study of § 5.5 reproduces; simulated oversight burden falls by 73% / 91% / 87% at the default overseer seed — point estimates that an external audit showed to be sensitive to the simulated overseer’s own random seed (0.45–0.95 on seed 1 across 1,000 overseer seeds), so we report pair-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals, which rerun the full dynamic-trust simulation per replicate: [ 0.59 , 0.94 ] [0.59,0.94] , [ 0.68 , 0.94 ] [0.68,0.94] , [ 0.71 , 0.94 ] [0.71,0.94] , all excluding zero (the criterion as we had written it named a Wilson interval, which is undefined for a burden ratio; the bootstrap is the applicable analogue, and the deviation is declared here); legitimate clarifying questions barely move ( − 2 -2 to − 4 -4 out of ∼ \sim 93 — and those few become proceed-when-ambiguous, 8 → \to 11, 6 → \to 8, 5 → \to 9 of ∼ \sim 100, an introduced error that the burden weights like an over-ask; § 6 ); the capability battery is unchanged (12 items at the time of these runs; the 50-item battery of § 5.4 was introduced afterwards) and the gate essentially never fires off-target (two battery firings in 36 items across seeds). The two controls, run under the same gate , are inert on Qwen. And the prompt-only baseline — “do not ask unnecessary questions” in the system prompt — makes things worse on every seed: interventions 67 → \to 80, 65 → \to 66, 72 → \to 82 (IRR − 20 % -20\% , − 1 % -1\% , − 11 % -11\% ). That contrast is the cleanest argument we have that internal intervention is not just a complicated way of writing an instruction.
blocks.zh: 门式指导评价是根据预先确定的标准进行的,每颗种子有200种新鲜情况,在Quen,有3种独立改良的种子。 模式与种子完全相同(图3):引入了这种盲目人类研究§5.5复制的计数;模拟监督负担从73%/91%/87%下降至预算监督员选择观看的计数;还计算了未观察的故障,总故障从91/86/95降至24/17/16(-74/-80/-83/X),因此,我们报告双组的靴子间隔为95%,在复制时重新进行完全的动态-信任模拟:[0.59、0.94][0.94], 原型为6.8、0.9的电池发射[0.68、0.94]的模拟监督负担,这是对模拟监督员本身的随机种子的敏感度(0.450-0.95),因此,我们报告这些双组的靴子间隔为95%,在复制时进行完全动态-信任模拟的计数为:[0.59、0.94][09、0.94] 原型的种子基本上为0.68、0.94 [0.94] 原型设备的零度差数为0.971,而未标定型为0.94 。 两个控制器在同一扇门下运行 昆文上是惰性的 而即时的基线——系统即时的“不问不必要的问题”——使每个种子的情况更糟糕:干预67 ~到80,65~~~66,72~~82(IRR−20%~20~,1%~1~,11%~11~11~). 这种对比是我们有的最干净的论点,即内部干预不仅仅是编写指示的复杂方式。

blocks.en: The gemma replication forced a refinement. There, the style-direction control is not inert: it flips 100% at the causal layer and, in gated steering, outperforms the behavior direction (IRR 89% vs 63%). The geometry explains it: on gemma the style and behavior directions share half their alignment ( cos \cos 0.48–0.53 at causal layers) while on Qwen they are nearly orthogonal (0.05–0.12). So the claim that survives cross-model is not “the behavior-probe direction is special”; it is that selectivity lives in the gate — which fires identically for every direction and never off-target — while the best lever direction is model-dependent. This changes how one should build such systems: invest in the gate; sweep the lever.
blocks.zh: Gemma的复制迫使我们进行了改进。 在那里,风格方向控制并非惰性:它在因果层上翻转100%,在门形方向盘中,表现优于行为方向(IRR 89%对63%). 几何学解释:在gemma上,风格和行为方向共享它们的一半对齐(cos 0.48–0.53在因果层),而在Quen上则接近正交(0.05–0.12). 因此在跨模型中幸存下来的说法并不是"行为-探险方向是特殊的";那就是选择性存在于大门中——这个门对每个方向都同样开火,从不偏离目标——而最好的杠杆方向则依赖于模型. 这改变了人们应如何建立这种系统:投资于大门;扫荡杠杆。

blocks.en: A natural rejoinder is that the entanglement might be an artifact of our dense probe basis — perhaps a sparse dictionary would separate what the probes cannot. Gemma conveniently has one: we repeated the analysis with a Gemma Scope JumpReLU sparse autoencoder ( Lieberum and others, 2024 ) (16k features, residual stream, layer 21 — the causal peak), under gates fixed in advance (transfer checks and one declared amendment; Appendix D ). The dictionary sharpens the picture rather than escaping it. Reading is impressively sparse: ten features match the dense probe’s near-perfect AUC on the behavioral label. But the entanglement reappears at feature resolution. The top-50 feature supports of the behavior and style axes share 19 features (0.15 expected for two unrelated sets) — a correspondence one expects given the dense cosine of 0.56, so we read it as the dictionary failing to escape the overlap, not as independent evidence. The causal content is in the clamps, on 78 held-out over-asks at the class-mean dose: the style-orthogonal behavior-specific features flip nothing (0/78); the style-specific features flip nothing either (0/78) while moving the style projection by − 2.1 -2.1 ; the shared features flip 4/78 (Wilson 95% [2, 12]%, not separable from 0/78 at this sample size, Fisher p = 0.12 p=0.12 ) while moving style by − 6.5 -6.5 ; and the ten AUC-matching readers themselves — clamped directly, in an arm added after an external audit found the original design never tested them — flip 7/78 ([4, 17]%, p = 0.014 p=0.014 against 0/78) at − 12.9 -12.9 , twice the shared arm’s style displacement (four of the ten sit inside the shared support). The random-feature arm moved nothing at all: its features are inactive on these episodes, so it is a null control of the clamping machinery, not a matched-magnitude placebo. What the arms support is this: on this model, at this site, the only sparse set that separates from zero is the readers, and it moves style the most; nothing that leaves style alone moves the decision — consistent with the readers acting through their style-shared components, though an arm clamping the six non-shared readers alone would be needed to show it. This is a sharper form of the readable-versus-causal dissociation that concurrent work reports for an agentic stop-feature ( Vicentino, 2026d ) , here in dictionary space with the entanglement measured. Auto-interp labels put a memorable face on the numbers (the shared features that flip literally encode the two reply openers; the inert behavior-specific ones are textbook detectors of choice and unclarity; Appendix D ), and we take the analysis as the geometric account restated at feature resolution, with the clamps as its causal content — and with its caveats stated: class-mean dose only, one layer, one model, and per-arm displacement norms not recorded.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的复辩是,缠绕可能是我们密集探测基础的一件文物——也许一个稀疏的字典会把探测器不能分开来. Gemma方便地有一个:我们用一台Gemma Asception Jump ReLU稀疏自动编码器(Lieberum等人,2024年)重复了分析(16k特性,残流,第21层——因果峰),在预先固定的门下(转移检查和宣布的一项修正;附录D)。 字典将画面磨亮而不是逃避. 阅读量相当稀少:十种特性与密集探测器在行为标签上几乎完美无缺的AUC相符。 但缠绕在特征分辨率上重新出现. 行为和风格轴的上-50特性支持共有19个特性(两个不相关套集的预期值为0.15)——考虑到0.56的密集余弦,人们期望一个函文,所以我们把它读为未能逃脱重叠的字典,而不是独立的证据. 因果内容位于夹子中,在类正剂量下为78个悬浮过度:样式-正态行为特性不翻转(0/78);样式特性不翻转任何(0/78),同时移动样式投影-2.1-2.1;共用特性翻转4/78(Wilson 95% [2,12]%,在此样本尺寸上不与0/78分开;Fisher p = 0.12 p=0.12),移动样式时为-6.5-6.5;10个AUC配对读器本身——直接夹住,在外部审计后添加的臂中——翻转7/78([4,17]%,p =0.014对0/78),在12.9-12.9时,共用臂的样式移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移位移 随机地臂完全没有移动:它的特点在这些事件上是没有活动的,所以它是钳子机械的无效控制,而不是匹配的放大安慰剂. 武器支持的就是这个:在这个模型上,在这个站点,唯一与零分开的稀疏的集是读者,它最动风格;没有什么能让风格独自移动决定——与读者通过风格共享的组件行事一致,尽管需要一只手臂将六个非共享的读者单独夹住来展示. 这是可读性与因果性脱节的一种更尖锐的形式,即同时工作报告一种代理性断层(Vicentino, 2026d),这里用测量的缠绕在字典空间中。 自动干扰标签在数字上贴了一个难忘的面孔(将两个解答打开器字面地翻转的共享特征;惰性行为特有的特征是教科书选择的检测器和不清晰的;附录D),我们把分析作为特征解析重现的几何账户,夹子是其因果内容——并附有说明:类-平均值剂量,一层,一个模型,以及没有记录的每个武器置换规范.

blocks.en: 5.4 Into the weights: the five-family map
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 入重:五家图.

blocks.en: The steering result leaves a practical objection: it needs probes and a hook at inference time. Can the correction be consolidated into the weights — and does mechanistic localization earn anything over just fine-tuning on the corrections? This section’s answer is a map, not a rule, and we give the map first.
blocks.zh: 转向结果留下了实际的反对意见:在推断时间需要探测器和钩子. 能否将校正整合到权重中去——机械化本地化是否仅通过微调校正而获得什么? 这个部分的答案是地图,而不是规则,我们首先给出地图.

blocks.en: Two LoRAs per model, trained on identical data (the labeling overseer’s canonical corrections for intervened episodes; the model’s own replies for clean ones — retention) with identical hyperparameters. The local variant restricts trainable parameters to the causal band identified in § 5.1 (on Qwen: layers 24–31, 3.3M parameters). The bc variant trains all layers (on Qwen: 15M parameters). Six criteria, fixed before any run. Four are pass/fail per arm: (a) interventions at least halved; (b) IRR ≥ 50 % \geq 50\% ; (c) legitimate clarifying questions drop by at most 10 of ∼ \sim 100 ( retention ); (d) capability battery drops at most 5 points. Two compare the arms: (e) localization must pay — local passes (a)–(d) with at most a third of bc ’s trainable parameters and either no worse a burden or smaller regressions on (c) and (d); (f) the edited burden is reported next to gated steering’s on the same scenarios, not as a pass/fail. On Qwen, (e) is met (3.3M against 15M parameters; burden 0.225 against bc ’s 0.205, with bc ’s retention loss the larger regression) and (f) reads 0.225 against gated steering’s 0.385. One outcome term used below: proceed-when-ambiguous — acting without asking on a genuinely ambiguous request, the failure retention is designed to catch in its extreme form. Every evaluation’s base row is checked against the model’s collection-time behavior before any edited number is read (§ 4.1 ; agreement within 8 points on every family and seed).
blocks.zh: 每个模型有两个LORA,接受相同数据的培训(标签监督员对干预事件的犬科更正;模型自己对干净事件的答复——保留),使用相同的超参数。 本地变体将可训练参数限制在§5.1(在Quen上:层24–31,3.3M参数)中确定的因果波段. bc变体列车各层(在Quen上:15M参数). 6条标准,在运行前固定。 4个是每只手臂通过/失效:(a) 干预至少减半;(b) IRR 50%\geq 50%\%;(c) 合理澄清问题,最多在 \\sim 100 (保留) 中10个;(d) 能力电池在最多5点时下降。 两种武器比较:(e) 当地化必须支付——当地通行证(a)-(d),最多可达到bc可训练参数的三分之一,而且不会比(c)和(d)造成更糟糕的负担或更小的倒退;(f) 在同样情况下,编辑后的负担报告在门牌方向盘旁边,而不是作为通过/失败。 在Qwen上,(e) 符合(3.3M比15M参数;负载0.225比bc的0.205,而bc的留存损失较大)和(f) 与门面转向架0.385对0.225。 下文使用的一个结果术语是:一时矛盾——在没有提出真正模棱两可的要求的情况下采取行动,保留失败是为了达到其极端目的。 在读取任何经编辑的编号之前,每个评价的基准行都要对照模型的收集时间行为(§4.1;在8点之内就每个家庭和种子达成协议)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: The five-family editing map, every row at three full-pipeline seeds (fresh collection → \to both LoRAs → \to both evaluations per seed; gemma at one seed). Each cell: verdict against the four per-arm criteria (a seed passes only if it meets all four; a row is pass only when every seed does, mixed otherwise, with the count), per-seed outcomes, and the failed criterion. The depth column is the test-side peak of the exploratory sweep, the value the two rules were scored on (OLMo-3 53%, Phi-4 55–85% along its plateau); Table 1 gives the frozen-protocol sites. No cheap measurement we tested (cosine column, peak-depth column) predicts the local column — both rules, written down in advance, were falsified out-of-family.
blocks.zh: 图4:每行三条全管种子的五家编辑图(新鲜的收集 ~\对两个LORAs →\对每个种子的评价;一个种子的Gemma). 每个单元格:根据四个每臂标准(一个种子只有在满足全部四个标准时才能通过;每个种子只有在每个种子都这样做时,才能通过,否则与计数混合),每个种子的结果,以及失败的标准. 深度栏是探索性扫荡的试验边峰,两项规则的得分值(OLMo-3 53%,Phi-4 55-85%沿着其高原);表1给出了冰冻-protocol遗址。 我们测试过的任何廉价的衡量标准(cosine专栏,峰值深度专栏)都预测当地专栏——这两条事先写下来的规则都是伪造的外出家庭.

blocks.en: Figure 4 is the deliverable, and three durable statements summarize it. (i) bc from overseer corrections is the default to beat, and it usually isn’t beaten — 9 of its 10 seed-arms outside Qwen pass everything — but it is not universally safe: it fails retention on all three Qwen seeds and on one Nemo seed, and in those failures it also disturbs an unrelated behavior (re-asking an already-answered question) that the base model showed rarely or never. When bc breaks something, it breaks it silently; check retention. (ii) Localized editing is neither miracle nor mirage. There is one replicated case — Qwen, 3/3 seeds, all criteria — where the aimed edit beats the default outright, with burden reductions of 84/85/86% and the capability battery unchanged (0.84 base; 0.84/0.86/0.84 edited, on 50 items); and there are three families where it fails in three different, diagnostic ways: unconditional collapse (gemma, Nemo), retention erosion (OLMo-3), and criterion-crossing instability (Phi-4, next paragraph). (iii) No cheap measurement we tested predicts the regime. Neither the decision axis’s entanglement with style nor the causal peak’s depth survived out-of-family prediction tests — both were written down before the tests, both were falsified, and per the stopping rule we had set ourselves no third rule was fit. The map is the deliverable: any future theory of when interpretability-guided editing wins has ten arm-outcomes, each with its prior prediction, to be consistent with, and two dead rules it must not re-derive.
blocks.zh: 图4是可交付品,三份持久声明对此作了总结。 (i) 监督员纠正的bc是默认击败的,它通常不是击败的——它的10个种子臂中9个在Quen外传遍了一切——但它并非普遍安全:它未能保留所有3个Quen种子和1个Nemo种子,在这些失败中,它也扰乱了一种无关的行为(再次询问一个已经回答过的问题),而基本模型很少或从未表现出来. 当bc打破某物时,它静静地打破;检查保留. (二) 本地化编辑既不是奇迹也不是幻影。 还有一个重复的案例——Quen, 3/3种子,所有标准——目标编辑完全胜过默认,减少84/85/86%,电池容量不变(0.84基;0.84/0.86/0.84编辑,涉及50个项目);有三个家庭以三种不同的诊断方式失灵:无条件崩溃(Gemma,Nemo),留存侵蚀(OLMo-3),以及标准交叉不稳定(Phi-4,下段)。 (三) 我们测试过的不便宜的计量预测制度。 无论是决定轴与风格的纠缠,还是因果峰的深度都未能幸免于家庭外的预测测试 — 两者都是在测试之前被写下来的,两者都是伪造的,而且根据我们自己制定的停止规则,没有第三条规则是合适的。 地图是可交付的:任何关于可解释性指南编辑何时获胜的将来理论,都有十臂结果,每个结果都有其之前的预测,以与它一致,并且两个死规则绝不能再犯.
