blocks.en: Note the base burdens, which are the denominators of IRR: Phi-4 is the only calibrated over-asker, so its baseline burden is already 0.40–0.54, against 1.40–1.54 on Qwen, 1.80 on gemma, 1.68–1.73 on OLMo-3 and 1.58–1.76 on Nemo; and about three quarters of Phi-4’s burden is watching (61 watched episodes against 10 interventions on seed 1), which an edit that removes failures reduces only slowly, because trust recovers gradually. A relative reduction on such a denominator swings widely with a handful of episodes — while on total failures the local arm removes 64%, 61% and 91% across the three seeds, above the bar on every seed. We write “crosses the boundary across full-pipeline seeds” rather than “unstable model” deliberately: each seed re-runs collection, training, and evaluation, so the variance includes all three. What the row establishes either way: the regime boundary this section maps does not just run between models; on Phi-4 it runs through the seeds of a single model — one more reason a deterministic which-strategy-wins rule was never a live option.
blocks.zh: 注意基本负担,即IRR的分母: Phi-4是唯一的校准过重者,因此其基线负担已经是0.40–0.54,而Quen上的是1.40–1.54,gemma上的是1.80,OLMo-3上的是1.68–1.73,Nemo上的是1.58–1.76;大约四分之三的Phi-4的负担正在观看(61年观看了节目,而种子1上的是10次干预),消除失败的编辑只是慢慢减少,因为信任逐渐恢复. 这种分母的相对减少随着几起事件而大范围地波动——而完全失败时,当地手臂在三种种子中除去64%、61%和91%,高于每个种子的栏杆。 我们写“跨越边界跨越全管种子”,而不是刻意写“不稳定的模式”:每个种子重新进行收集、训练和评价,因此差异包括所有三种。 该行确定的方式是:本节所绘制的政权边界并不仅仅是在模型之间运行的;在Phi-4上,它穿过单一模型的种子——另一个原因是确定性的战略胜负规则从来不是一个活命的选择。

blocks.en: The rest of this section is the audit trail — how each row landed, in the order it happened, with the prediction we had written down next to each outcome.
blocks.zh: 本节的其余部分是审计线索——每一行是如何降落的,按照发生的顺序,以及我们在每个结果旁边记录的预测。

blocks.en: Qwen, then gemma: the double dissociation. On Qwen the local edit passes every criterion on all three seeds while bc — same data, same recipe, 4.5 × \times the parameters — reaches comparable headline burden (86/78/82%) and fails the retention criterion every time ( − 14 / − 11 / − 12 -14/-11/-12 ), while introducing the de-novo re-ask failure (15/9/11 episodes of 100). Spreading the parameters let the optimizer generalize “ask less” indiscriminately; confining them to the causal band did not. Then gemma inverted it: the restricted edit over-generalizes catastrophically (never asks: 100/100 unambiguous episodes acted, 100/100 ambiguous too — both “perfect” scores audited per our impossible-numbers protocol), while all-layers bc is clean and even improves legitimate clarifying ( + 11 +11 ). A perfect anti-diagonal — a double dissociation , which rules out both trivial readings (localization generically helps; localization generically hurts).
blocks.zh: Quen,然后是gemma:双离合. 在Quen上,当地编辑通过所有三个种子的每个标准,而bc——同样的数据、同样的食谱、4.5×\时间参数——达到可比头条负担(86/78/82 %),并且每次都没有保留标准(-14 /− 11 /− 12-14/11/12),同时引入了脱新程序重置失败(15/9/11集,100). 扩大参数使优化者不加区别地概括“任务较少”,将其限制在因果波段内并没有。 然后Gemma颠倒了它:受限制的编辑过度概括了灾难性(从未问过:百/百的不含糊事件,百/百的模棱两可——都是根据我们不可能的数字协议审计的“完美”分数),而所有层次的bc是干净的,甚至改进了合理的澄清(+11+11). 一个完美的反对角——双离子,它排除了两种细微的读数(局部化一般帮助;局部化一般伤害).

blocks.en: The rule. The two models differ on a measurement we already had: cos ⁡ ( behavior , style ) ≈ 0.12 \cos(\text{behavior},\text{style})\approx 0.12 on Qwen vs ≈ 0.52 \approx 0.52 on gemma. Hypothesis: entangled geometry needs distributed capacity; orthogonal geometry lets a narrow edit cut cleanly. A band-width sweep, with its predictions written down beforehand, supported the story within-model (Figure 6 ) and produced the section’s sharpest concept: widening the band on gemma reveals two ordered thresholds — below the first (3 layers) the adapter cannot even fit the corrections; between them (8–12 layers) it fits them but generalizes as the crude unconditional rule (“never ask”); only above the second (18 of 26 layers, 69% of depth) can it afford the conditional policy (“act when unique, keep asking when not”). Qwen passes at 8 of 36 layers (22%). Capacity for a correction and capacity for its conditionality are different, ordered thresholds; the gap between them is the collapse zone. (One sweep sub-prediction died here and is reported: three layers do not suffice on Qwen, − 20 -20 .) We wrote the cosine rule down as a mechanical prediction procedure for any new model.
blocks.zh: 规矩 这两个模型在我们已有的测量方法上是不同的:cos QQ(行为,风格) QQ 0.12\cos(\text{行为},\text{style})\在Quen vs 0.52\\0.52在gemma上大约0.12。 假说:缠绕的几何需要分布容量;正交几何允许狭义的剪切干净. 一个带宽的扫荡,加上预先写下来的预测,支持了模式内的故事(图6),并产生了这个部分最尖锐的概念:在Gemma上扩大带宽,揭示出两个命令阈值——低于第一个(3层),适配器甚至不能适应修正;在它们之间(8至12层),它适合它们,但作为粗糙的无条件规则(从不问");只有第二层以上(26层,深度69%),它能够承受有条件的政策( " 独特时继续询问,不问时 " )。 Quen以36层中的8层(22%)通过. 纠正能力及其附加条件的能力不同,有秩序的阈值;它们之间的差距是崩溃区。 (一次扫荡的副防疫员在这里死亡,据报道:在Quen上三层是不够的, - 20-20。 ) 我们把余弦规则写下来了 作为任何新模型的机械预测程序。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Band-width sweep: retention (top) and IRR (bottom) against edit-band width as a fraction of model depth. Gemma shows the two ordered thresholds — too narrow to fit, wide enough to fit but only unconditionally, wide enough for the conditional policy; Qwen passes at 22% of depth.
blocks.zh: 图6:带宽扫描:保留(顶部)和IRR(底部)相对于编辑-带宽作为模型深度的一小部分. Gemma 显示两个命令的阈值——太窄不能适应,宽到足够适合但只能无条件适应,宽到有条件的政策;Quen通过深度的22%.

blocks.en: Round one out-of-family: the rule dies. OLMo-3 measured cos = 0.07 \cos=0.07 — Qwen-like, the cleanest disentanglement in the sample. Prediction written down beforehand: local passes, bc fails retention. Outcome, on the repaired harness (§ 4.1 ): the exact inverse. local eroded legitimate clarifying (94 → \to 79; everything else passing); bc was spotless (94 → \to 94, IRR 90%). A model with Qwen’s geometry behaved like gemma. What died is the prediction rule ; the Qwen/gemma dissociation is a pair of measurements and stood. One observation emerged from the wreckage — OLMo-3’s causal peak sits at 53% of depth (L17, the test-side peak of the exploratory sweep, on which the local band L13–L20 was centred and on which the depth rule was scored; the frozen protocol adopted later lands at L21, 66%, on the same plateau, Table 1 , a depth at which the revised rule would have made no prediction) versus 78–81% for Qwen/gemma; perhaps a mid-stack band leaves too much downstream computation free to re-absorb the edit — and per § 4.5 it was written down before the next two models ran, labeled post-hoc, side by side with the original rule and with the stopping rule.
blocks.zh: 第1轮出家人:规则失效. OLMo-3测量的COs = 0.07\cos= 0.07 — 类似Quen,是样本中最干净的脱落. 事先写下预测:当地通行证,bc未保留。 结果,关于修复的吊带(第4.1节):准确的反向:当地侵蚀的合法澄清(94~~~~到79;其他一切经过);bc无斑点(94~~~~到94,IRR90%)。 一个带有Quen几何特征的模型表现得像Gemma. 死亡的是预测规则; Quen/gemma离散是一对测量并站立. 从残骸中出现了一种观察——OLMo-3的因果关系峰值位于53%的深度(L17,探索性扫描的试验端峰值,当地乐队L13-L20以该峰值为中心,并以此为深度规则打分;后来通过的冻结协议位于L21,66%,在同一高原上,表1,经修订的规则不会作出预测),而Quen/gemma为78-81%;也许一个中层的波段留下了太多的下游计算,无法重新吸收编辑——而根据第4.5节,它是在下两个模型运行之前写下来的,标注在后层,与原来的规则和停止规则并列。

blocks.en: Round two: the discriminating model. Nemo-12B measured entangled and mid-stack ( cos \cos 0.42, peak 55%): both rules agreed local would fail, and it did, spectacularly (clarify − 51 -51 ; confirmation without discrimination). Phi-4 was the prize: a causal plateau from 55% of depth with the cosine rising along it (0.21 → \to 0.52) — under the declared first-argmax convention, the original rule said local passes , the revised rule said local fails retention . Opposite predictions, one outcome. The outcome: both wrong. Retention held ( − 9 -9 , within criterion), killing the revised rule; burden reduction missed the bar (IRR 28%), killing the original’s “passes everything”. bc passed everything. The stopping rule we had set ourselves named two cases — diverging rules, where the outcome picks a survivor, and concordant wrong rules, where one stops; Phi-4 produced the case it did not name, diverging and both wrong, and we applied its evident intent: no third rule; what would predict the regime is a question for theory, not for another variable adjusted on the same five points.
blocks.zh: 第二轮:歧视模式. Nemo-12B测量了缠绕和中层(cos 0.42,峰值55%):当地商定的两条规则都会失败,而且是惊人的(澄清-51-51;确认无差别)。 Phi-4是奖品:由55%的深度(0.21~~~~~0.52)上升而来的一个因果高原, 对面预测,一个结果。 结果:两者都是错误的。 保留(-9-9,在标准范围内),破坏了订正规则;减轻负担错过了酒吧(28%爱尔兰里亚尔),使原作的 " 一切过关 " 。 bc 通过了一切。 我们自己制定的停止规则将两个案例命名为:不同规则,结果选择幸存者,一致的规则,一个停止;Phi-4提出了它没有命名、有区别和两者都是错误的案例,我们运用了它的明显意图:没有第三种规则;对制度作出预测的是一个理论问题,而不是对同一五点进行调整的另一个变量的问题。

blocks.en: Replication. The three new rows began as single-seed results, so the campaign’s last act was seeds 2 and 3 for each — full pipeline, with each row’s stability written down as the prediction and any arm flip declared reportable. The map held, with two divergences, reported as the rule required, that sharpen it: Nemo’s bc arm failed retention on one seed of three ( − 15 -15 , amplifying re-ask 8 → \to 21 — the “ bc disturbs something unrelated” pattern on a second family), and Phi-4’s local arm produced the seed-crossing row above, including one full pass. Both divergences are in the map; neither was absorbed.
blocks.zh: 复说. 新三排开始为单种子结果,因此竞选最后的动作是每排种子2和3——全管,每排稳定性写成预测,任何手臂翻转都宣布可以报告. 尼莫的bc臂在3个种子上保留失败(15-15个,扩大任务8)至21个, " bc扰动了第二个家庭的无关东西 " 模式), Phi-4的当地手臂在上方制作了一个种子横行,包括一个完整的通行证。 两种分歧都在地图中;两者都没有被吸收。

blocks.en: 5.5 Do humans agree with the judges?
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 人类同意法官的意见吗?

blocks.en: Every number above flows through the two automated overseers of § 3 , so both were audited by humans before we relied on them — with a hierarchy of evidence worth stating explicitly, strongest first.
blocks.zh: 上面的每一个数字都流经第3节的两个自动监督员,所以在我们依赖它们之前,两者都经过了人类的审计——首先需要明确、最强的证据等级。

blocks.en: A second annotator, working from a standalone bundle with opaque episode IDs and no ground-truth fields, agreed with the rule overseer at κ = 0.900 \kappa=0.900 on 60 stratified collection episodes (and κ = 0.967 \kappa=0.967 with annotator 1), matching the intervention type in 28 of 30 shared interventions. On the separate blind pre/post-steering study (60 episodes, shuffled, policy never shown), the same annotator reached κ = 0.921 \kappa=0.921 and judged the intervention reduction at − 81 % -81\% against the overseer’s − 87 % -87\% on the same sample. Disclosure: three of this annotator’s blind verdicts were confirmed input errors (intended y , pressed n ), corrected with an audit trail; κ \kappa before correction was 0.791 — both values reported.
blocks.zh: 第二位注释员从一个独立的捆绑带不透明的插曲ID,没有地面混杂的字段,与规则监督员就60个分级集合集(和0.967\kappa=0.967与注释员1)达成一致,在30个共享介入中28个介入类型相匹配. 在独立的盲目前/后试验研究(60集,洗牌,政策从未显示)中,同一注释员达到0.921\kappa=0.921,并在同一样本中根据监督员的81%-81%-87=====判断干预减少。 披露:这名注释员的三项盲判是经证实的输入错误(意图y,按n),经过审计线索纠正;更正前为0.791的\kappa——两种数值都报告。

blocks.en: Annotator 1 (the first author) agreed with the rule overseer at κ = 0.933 \kappa=0.933 on the κ \kappa study and reproduced the evaluation overseer’s verdicts on all 60 blind episodes ( κ = 1.0 \kappa=1.0 ). We weight this below the independent annotator’s numbers, and disclose that episode IDs (which encode ground truth in a suffix) were inadvertently visible during the κ \kappa study; the annotator reports not having noticed them, the CLI was fixed, and every later study used opaque IDs.
blocks.zh: 注释员1(第一作者)同意规则监督员在0.933\kappa=0.933上对okappa的研究,并转载了评估监督员对所有60起盲事件的裁决(ob =1.0\kappa=1.0). 我们把这一点放在独立注释员的数下,并披露插曲ID(用后缀编码地面真相)在xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

blocks.en: The human studies validate the verdicts (intervene / don’t, and failure type) and the intervention reductions . The budgeted overseer’s burden dynamics were not directly human-validated — and proved unstable on 30-episode subsamples (trust dynamics amplify single verdict flips) — so burden-based IRR is reported as the automated operational proxy, always alongside full-attention failure counts. The most informative annotation outcome is the structure of the residual disagreements: every one involves a clarifying question that offers a spurious option (three on genuinely ambiguous requests, where the annotators judged the question legitimate and the rule agreed; four type-only disagreements on over-asks, two per study, where both intervened but labeled the failure differently) — a quality defect our taxonomy does not yet cover and the natural first entry of a policy v3.
blocks.zh: 人类研究验证了判决(intervene/ don't, 以及失败类型)和干预减少。 预算监督员的负担动态没有直接经过人验证,在30集的子样本(信任动态放大单一判决翻版)上也证明不稳定,因此,基于负担的IRR被报告为自动操作代用,总是与全心全意的失败计数一起。 最说明性的结果是残余分歧的结构:每个分歧都涉及一个澄清问题,提出一个虚假的选择(三个是真正含糊不清的要求,其中注释者认为问题合法,规则也同意;四个只涉及任务过多的分歧,每个研究两个,两个都干预了,但给失败贴上了不同的标签)——一个质量缺陷,我们的分类学尚未涵盖,一个政策v3的自然第一进入。

blocks.en: 5.6 When it isn’t in the weights
blocks.zh: 5.6 (中文(简体) ). 当它不在重量中时

blocks.en: Our first primary failure candidate was not over-asking. It was re-asking after the answer : across three models, in 45–67% of episodes the agent asked a legitimate question, received the answer, and asked again instead of acting. Before localizing anything we ran a scaffold ablation, and the effect collapsed to exactly zero on both models tested (Qwen2.5-3B, gemma-2-2b) once the step-2 context included the agent’s own step-1 question. The failure was real, frequent, and system-level : the agent literally could not see that it had already asked. Weight editing would have “fixed” a bug that a one-line scaffold change fixes for free — or worse, would have trained the model to never ask twice, damaging the legitimate re-ask cases.
blocks.zh: 我们的第一个主要失败候选人并不是任务过重。 在三个模式中, 在45-67%的剧集中, 经纪人问了一个合理的问题, 得到了答案, 在将任何东西本地化之前,我们运行了一个脚手架膨胀,一旦步骤-2的上下文包括了代理商自己的步骤-1问题,效果在两个被测试的模型(Qun2.5-3B,gemma-2-2b)上完全崩溃为零. 失败是真实的、频繁的和系统层面的:从字面上看,代理人看不出它已经问过了。 重量编辑会“固定”一个错误,一个单行脚手架可以免费修正——或者更糟的是,会训练模型永远不要问两次,破坏合法的重案处理。

blocks.en: We keep this result for two reasons. Methodologically, it motivates the blocking checks of § 4.1 : the entire class of “the agent doesn’t know X” bugs is invisible in aggregate metrics and fatal to intervention studies. Scientifically, it is the first entry of a when-to-edit decision procedure — scaffold ablations are cheap and should gate any mechanistic pipeline. And note the asymmetry with § 5.4 : the bc edit introduced re-asking on Qwen (and amplified it on one Nemo seed) in the repaired scaffold where the model sees its own question — we verified that both the training data and the evaluation use the repaired scaffold, so this is a weight-level cause for the same surface behavior that the ablation showed can also have a context-level cause. Surface behavior underdetermines the fix.
blocks.zh: 我们保留这一结果有两个原因。 从方法上讲,它激发了第4.1节的阻断检查:整个类的 " 毒剂不知道X " 虫在总的测量中是看不见的,对干预研究是致命的。 从科学上讲,这是在编辑后决定程序的第一个入口——脚手架的塌方是便宜的,应该堵住任何机械管道。 注意与§5.4的不对称: bc编辑在修复的脚手架上引入了重置Quen(并在一个尼莫种子上放大),模型在那里看到了自己的问题——我们核实了训练数据和评价都使用了修复的脚手架,因此这是同样表面行为的重量级原因,所显示的同样表面行为也可以有上下文级原因. 表面行为 下决定固定。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: The scope statements are placed where the claims are made (§ 1 , § 3 , § 5 ); this section collects the main limitations. The environment is a deliberately small causal testbed — one-line tasks, three-item workspaces, a rule-defined overseer — and nothing here demonstrates transfer to naturalistic agent traces; the LLM-judge overseer and the failure taxonomy are built for that replication, which is future work. The eligibility window is narrow (five of thirteen candidate families — the first two plus three of the eleven screened later; Appendix A ), and all “five for five” statements live inside it. Under greedy decoding, behavior is a deterministic function of the prompt, which is why every claim is anchored to causal interventions and controls rather than decodability; sampled-decoding replications are cheap and pending. The regime boundary of § 5.4 is mapped , not explained — n = 5 n=5 , with the boundary passing through one model’s full-pipeline seed variance — and we deliberately declined to answer “what property determines the regime” with a third data-fitted rule; we consider it the paper’s most important open question. The H-misrep signature rests on one family. The SAE analysis is one dictionary, one layer, class-mean dose. The style-direction control proved model-dependent (§ 5.3 ) — reframed, not hidden. Human validation rests on two annotators with disclosed corrections, validating verdicts and intervention reductions but not the burden dynamics. The burden also weights every intervention alike: an over-ask and an action taken on a genuinely ambiguous request cost the same, although the second is the more consequential error, and gated steering trades a few of the former for a few of the latter (§ 5.3 ); an input crafted to fool the belief probe would make the gate force exactly that error. Retention has a blind spot of the same kind: the rule counts any clarifying question on an ambiguous request as correct, so a drop in the quality of questions — the spurious-option defect of § 5.5 — would pass criterion (c) unseen. Interference across multiple simultaneous edits is untested. And none of these edits should be presumed adversarially robust — concurrent work finds located-and-edited mechanisms collapse under adaptive attack ( Vicentino, 2026a ) ; our claims are about oversight economics under distribution, not guarantees.
blocks.zh: 范围说明放在提出债权的地方(§1,§3,§5);本节收集主要限制. 环境是一个故意小的因果测试床——一线任务,三项目工作空间,一个规则定义的监督员——这里没有任何东西显示向自然剂痕迹的转移;LLM法官监督员和故障分类学是为这种复制而建造的,这是未来的工作. 资格窗口范围狭窄(13个候选家庭中的5个——在后来筛选的11个家庭中的前2个加3个;附录A),所有“五分之五”的报表都在里面。 在贪婪的解码下,行为是即时器的决定性功能,这就是为什么每个诉求都根植于因果干预和控制而不是解码;抽样的解码复制是便宜的,有待处理. 第5.4节的政权边界是绘制的,没有解释——n = 5n = 5,边界穿过一个模型的全管种子差异,我们故意拒绝用第三个数据规则回答“什么财产决定政权”;我们认为这是该文件最重要的未决问题。 H-Misrep的签名是一个家庭。 SAE分析是一个词典,一层,类-平均值剂量. 风格方向控制被证明是模型依赖的(§5.3)——重新设定,而不是隐藏. 人类验证取决于两个有披露的更正、验证判决和减少干预的注释员,而不是负担动态。 这种负担也使每一项干预都具有同等的份量:任务过重,对真正含糊的请求采取行动,其代价也一样,尽管第二个是更间接的错误,而门面的引导交易对前者中的少数进行(第5.3节);为欺骗信念探测器而制作的输入会使大门产生完全相同的错误。 保留有同样的盲点:规则将澄清任何问题都算在模棱两可的要求上是正确的,因此,问题质量的下降——第5.5节的虚假的可选缺陷——会通过标准(c)。 对多个同时编辑的干扰没有经过测试. 这些编辑都不应该被假定为具有对抗力——同时发现定位和编辑的机制在适应性攻击下崩溃(Vicentino, 2026a);我们的说法是关于正在分发的监督经济学,而不是保证。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and what comes next
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和下一步工作

blocks.en: The through-line of this paper is that oversight signal is data about the model’s internals , not just data about the desired output. Read that way, an intervention log becomes a localization dataset; a supervisor’s correction becomes a causal experiment; and “did the edit work?” becomes a question about the overseers around the system — did they have to step in less? — rather than about a probe set.
blocks.zh: 本文的通过线是,监督信号是模型内部的数据,而不仅仅是预期产出的数据。 如此一来,一个干预日志就变成了本地化数据集;一个主管的校正就变成了一个因果实验;而“编辑工作是否成了关于系统周围监督员的问题——他们是否必须少步走?” 而不是一个探测器

blocks.en: What we did not get is the compass we had set out to find: no cheap measurement we tested tells you, before training, whether localized editing will beat imitation on your model. The right reading of the five-family map is that the question is real, open, and — within this experimental design — now well-posed: the failure modes are discrete and diagnostic, the one stable success replicates, the boundary is sharp enough to pass between the seeds of a single model, and any future theory has ten arm-outcomes, each with its prior prediction, to be consistent with plus two falsified rules to not re-derive. Getting there took nothing exotic: predictions written down before runs, conventions declared before they mattered, and a stopping rule honored when honoring it hurt. The falsification is the most load-bearing result in this paper precisely because we could not have talked our way out of it.
blocks.zh: 我们没有找到的就是我们所找到的指南针: 我们测试过的不便宜的测量方法,在训练前告诉你, 本地化的编辑是否会比模仿你的模型好。 对五家图的正确解读是,这个问题是真实的,开放的,并且——在这个实验设计中——现在可以很好地把握:故障模式是离散的和诊断的,一个稳定的成功复制,边界足够尖锐,在一个单一模型的种子之间传递,任何未来的理论都有十个臂结结果,每个结果都与其先前的预测一致,与两个假规则加起来,不重复. 得到它不需要什么异国情调:在运行前写下的预测,在重要之前宣布的公约,以及尊重它时遵守的停止规则。 弄虚作假是本文中最具负荷的结果,正因为我们无法说服我们摆脱它。

blocks.en: Three directions follow. First, the regime-boundary question itself: the two-thresholds result suggests the answer involves how much downstream computation can re-absorb a mid-stack edit — measurable, but only on models chosen before the measurement, as we learned. Second, richer failure types: the taxonomy includes correction-propagation and wrong-object failures that need multi-step tasks, and the H-caution/H-misrep split predicts different fixes should win on different models — a testable clinical claim. Third, the when-to-edit ladder that § 5.6 opened: scaffold ablation → \to prompt intervention → \to gated steering → \to weight edit, each rung cheaper and more reversible than the next; the interesting question is which measurements let you pick the right rung early. The probe readout of § 5.2 is one such measurement; finding the rest is the program.
blocks.zh: 三个方向跟着。 第一,制度边界问题本身:两点结果表明,答案涉及下游的计算可以重新吸收多少中层编辑——可以衡量,但只能根据我们所学到的测量前选择的模型。 第二,更丰富的故障类型:分类学包括需要多步骤任务的校正传播和错误对象故障,H-caution/H-Misrep分裂预测不同的修复方法应该在不同模型上获胜——一种可测试的临床索赔. 第三,第5.6节所打开的到编辑的阶梯:脚手架断裂 \\ to 迅速干预 \ to gated director \ to 重量编辑,每跑比下一跑更便宜,更可逆;有趣的问题是,哪个测量可以让你提早选择正确的跑步. 探测器读出第5.2节就是这样一种测量;发现的其余部分是程序.

blocks.en: Appendix A The eleven-candidate screening
blocks.zh: 附录A 十一名候选人的筛选

blocks.en: The behavioral-contrast eligibility requirement (§ 3 ) turned out to be the scarce resource, and we report the full screening because the failure modes are themselves informative about where this method applies. Eleven instruct-model families were screened for the three later replication slots, under identical prompts and scoring. Three became eligible, all via a load path that wraps the HF forward pass instead of re-implementing the architecture: OLMo-3-7B (90% over-ask, clean contrast — initially excluded for a broken port that our context-sensitivity canary caught producing bit-identical last-position activations across different prompts, then resurrected on the new path), Mistral-Nemo-12B (84% over-ask), and Phi-4 (37% over-ask, 63 direct actions — the calibrated profile of § 5.2 ). Eight were excluded, in three clusters. Always-ask (3): Apertus-8B, Llama-3.2-3B and OLMo-2-1B ask on literally 100/100 unambiguous requests — coherent, well-formed questions under an unconditional policy, leaving zero direct actions to contrast against (OLMo-2-1B additionally re-asks the same question after receiving the answer, 100/100 — a real correction-propagation failure, unstudiable here for the same reason). Never-ask (2): Phi-3-mini proceeds without questions on 99% of ambiguous requests (a mirror-image failure profile and a natural subject for a future failure type); gemma-3-1b-it acts on 100/100 ambiguous requests, 62 on the wrong object. Format non-compliance (3): Mistral-7B-v0.1 (20% invalid replies), Yi-6B (87% invalid), Qwen3-1.7B (emits its reasoning trace, 200/200 invalid). Small instruct models overwhelmingly sit at a degenerate corner of this task — which is precisely why a calibrated failure with behavioral contrast is the scarce resource this method needs, and why we report every exclusion: the applicability window is real and narrower than we would like.
blocks.zh: 行为矛盾的资格要求(§ 3)被证明是稀缺的资源,我们报告完全筛选,因为失败模式本身对这个方法适用的地方有所了解. 在相同的提示和评分下,为后来的三个复制档次筛选了11个指导模型家庭。 三条都获得了资格,它们都通过一个负载路径来包裹高频前传而不是重新实施架构:OLMo-3-7B(90%的超任务,干净的对比度——最初不包括一个断开的端口——我们的环境敏感性金丝雀发现在不同的提示上产生比特-同位最后位置激活,然后在新路径上复活),Mistral-Nemo-12B(84%的超任务)和Phi-4(37%的超任务,63个直接动作——第5.2节的校准剖面). 8个被排除在外,分为三组。 总是任务(3):Apertus-8B,Llama-3.2-3B和OLMo-2-1B就字面上100/100明确的请求——在无条件的政策下连贯而完善的问题——提出,使得零直接行动来对比(OLMo-2-1B在得到答案后又重新提出同样的问题,100/100——一个真正的校正传播失败,出于同样的原因在这里无法研究). Never-ask (2):Phi-3-mini在99%的模糊请求(一个镜像故障简介和一个未来故障类型的自然主体)上没有质疑;gemma-3-1b-it作用于100/100的模糊请求,62作用于错误对象. 格式不符合(3):Mistral-7B-v0.1(20%无效答复),Yi-6B(87%无效),Qune3-1.7B(包含其推理追踪,200/200无效). 小型指示模型压倒性地坐落在这一任务的一个堕落的角落——这正是为什么用行为对比来校准失败是这种方法需要的稀缺资源,以及为什么我们报告每一个排除:适用性窗口是真实的,而且比我们所希望的要窄。

blocks.en: Appendix C The five harness bugs
blocks.zh: 附录C 五个绳子虫

blocks.en: Each entry: the bug, the check that exposed it, and the regression test that now guards it. 1. OLMo-3 port produced context-insensitive activations (the legacy port left an attention weight unfilled): the context-sensitivity canary — different prompts must yield different last-position activations — caught bit-identical activations; fix: the HF-wrapping load path, with the canary made blocking in every probe run. Would have manufactured a conclusion: probes and patches on garbage activations. 2. The episode runner did not stop at the end-of-turn token ( ACTION: d1 became ACTION: d1user ): the base-row audit of § 4.1 exposed a deflated base model; fix: stop on the tokenizer’s special tokens, with two tests. Would have manufactured a conclusion: every edit flattered against a broken base. 3. Sparse-dictionary capture in the wrong basis (the measurement stack’s weight preprocessing changes residual-stream values; Gemma Scope was trained on raw values): a reconstruction error of 8.65 next to a healthy sparsity at the transfer gate set off an audit, and the audit found the basis mismatch; fix: a raw-basis load flag, with a test. The number itself did not distinguish the bug — after the fix it read 8.58, because the variance-normalized metric was broken by the twin design (Appendix D ) — so this one was caught by reading, not by the gate, and its effect on the downstream analysis was never measured. 4. A wrapped model handed to the bridge stayed on the CPU : a device assertion at load time; fix: an explicit move. A performance bug, no conclusion at stake. 5. Reference cycles kept the base model in GPU memory during the edited evaluation : an out-of-memory failure on the largest model; fix: explicit collection between the two models. A performance bug, no conclusion at stake.

blocks.en: Appendix D SAE instrument details (gemma, layer 21)
blocks.zh: 附录D SAE仪器细节(Gemma,第21层)

blocks.en: Dictionary: Gemma Scope JumpReLU SAE, 16k features, residual stream, layer 21 (the causal peak of § 5.1 ). The SAEs are trained on the pretrained gemma-2-2b; transfer to the instruct variant was gated before any result was read: relative reconstruction error 0.18 on our activations, sparsity in range, with one declared caveat (the final formatting token is partially out of distribution for the dictionary — a five-prompt diagnostic, three of them identical, gave 0.87 variance-normalized error there against 0.34 on content tokens; indicative, not a measurement). One amendment, declared before any downstream result was read: the original gate used a variance-normalized reconstruction metric that our twin design breaks by construction (twins are nearly identical, so between-episode variance is artificially small); the amendment — to a relative-error gate — was written down before the downstream analyses were run. Secondary observation, reported for completeness: the world representation is not sparse in this dictionary — fifty features recover only 0.80 of the dense belief probe’s 0.99 AUC — while the behavior label needs ten. Auto-interp labels (Neuronpedia ( Lin, 2023 ) , offered as color rather than evidence): the shared features that flip are labeled “questions and inquiries” (top tokens: question , ask ) and carry ACTION — literally the two reply openers — plus “certainty or doubt”; the inert behavior-specific set includes textbook detector features (“user choices”: choice , choose ; “unclear or undetermined”: unknown , unclear ). The model’s representation of there being a choice is not what emits the question; the features that write the reply’s first word are.
blocks.zh: 词典 : Gemma Asception JumpreLU SAE, 16k特征,残流, 第21层(第5.1节的因果峰值). SAE接受关于预先训练的gemma-2-2b的培训;在读到任何结果之前,向指示变体的转录就被门开:我们激活时的相对重建错误0.18,范围上是痉挛,有一个宣布的警告(词典的最后格式化符号部分不在分发范围——一个五速诊断,其中三个完全相同,在内容符号上给出了0.87差异正常化错误;指示性而非衡量)。 在下游结果宣读之前宣布的一项修正案:原大门使用差异-常态化的重建指标,即我们的双层设计因施工而中断(双层几乎完全相同,因此各层间差异人为小);修正案——相对反差门——是在下游分析进行之前写下来的。 副观察,报告为完整性:本词典中的世界代表性并不稀少——50个特征只恢复了密集的信仰探测器0.99 AUC中的0.80个——而行为标签需要10个. 自动干扰标签(Neuronpedia (Lin, 2023年),作为颜色而不是证据提供):翻转的共享特征被标注为"问题和询问"(顶号:问,问),并带有Action(字面意思是两个解答开者),加上"不确定或怀疑";惰性行为特定集包括教科书检测器特征(“用户选择”:选择,选择;“不明确或未确定”:未知,不明). 模型表示有选择并不是问题所在;撰写答复的第一个字的特征是。
